9 In compounds: —

a. מִלְּ מִבַּ֫עַד, מִבַּלְעֲדֵי, מִבֵּין, מֵאֵת, מֵאַחֲרֵי,‎ (common in Late Hebrew, **for מִלְּ‎ in Mishna see e.g. Babylonian Mez 7:10; Kil 8:1; Ter 8:11; Pes 1:6; Taan 2:7; Yeb 8:2; Ecclesiastes 4:17 מִלַּעֲשׂוֺת‎ (have no knowledge so as not to do evil) is read by Siegf Wild; especially before infinitive; in O.T. only in מִלְּבוֺא מִלְּבַד,‎ (above 5a), מִלִּפְנֵי מִלְּפָנִים, מִלְּעֻמַּת, מִלְמַ֫טָּה, מִלְמַ֫עְלָה,‎, and, si vera lectio, הֶחָ֑רֶס מִלְמַעֲלֵה‎ Judg 8:13, see מַעֲלֶה‎), מִתַּ֫חַת מֵעִם, מֵעַל, מִנֶּגֶד,‎; see אֵת אַחֲרֵי,‎, etc.

b. לְמִן‎ (לְמִנִּי‎ Micah 7:12 (twice in verse)), with לְ‎ pleonastic, from = מִן‎, but used almost exclusively of the terminus a quo, whether of space or time (compare מִן‎

5); — (I) of space, Deut 4:32; Judg 20:1 שֶׁבַע וְעַדבְּֿאֵר לְמִדַּן‎, Micah 7:12.7:12 (both לְמִנִּי‎), Zech 14:10; 1Chr 5:9; לְמֵרָחוֺק‎ from afar Job 36:3; 39:29 (on Ezra 3:13; 2Chr 26:15, see below לְ עַד‎); לְ לְמִתַּחַת‎ = underneath 1Kin 7:32. Idiomatic, especially followed by וְעַד‎, to denote comprehensively an entire class, בְּהֵמָה וְעַד לְמֵאִישׁ‎ Exod 11:7; Jer 51:62 (לְמֵאָדָם‎), אִשָּׁה וְעַד לְמֵאִישׁ‎ 2Sam 6:19; 2Chr 15:13, גָּדוֺל וְעַד לְמִקָּטֹן‎ 2Kin 23:2; Jer 42:8, simil. 2Chr 15:13; Jer 31:34; Est 1:5, 20, וְעַדטֿוֺב לְמֵרָע‎ 2Sam 13:22, שָׁנָה עֶשְׂרִים לְמִבֶּן וּלְמָ֑טָּה‎ 1Chr 27:23, compare 2Chr 25:5. — On לְמִבֵּית‎ Num 18:7. (2) of time (often following by עַד‎), ֗֗֗ אֲשֶׁר הַיּוֺם לְמִן‎ from the day when . . ., Deut 4:32; 9:7; 2Sam 7:11 (|| 1Chr 17:10 אֲשֶׁר וּלְמִיָּמִים‎) Jer 7:25; 32:31; Hag 2:18; ֗֗֗ אֲשֶׁר הַיָּמִים לְמִקְצָת‎ Dan 1:18; הַיּוֺם לְמִן‎ followed by infinitive (in apposition) Exod 9:18; 2Sam 19:25; לְמִיּוֺם‎ followed by infinitive (genitive) Judg 19:30; 2Sam 7:6; Isa 7:17; ֗֗֗ לְמִימֵי‎ 2Kin 19:25 (|| Isa 37:26 מימי‎) Mal 3:7; למןֿ עולם ועד עולם‎ Jer 7:7; 25:5; לְמֵרָחוֺק‎ from afar = long before, 2Sam 7:19 = 1Chr 17:17; 2Kin 19:25 = Isa 37:26.

מְנָאוֺת‎ see מְנָת‎ below מנה‎. below

[מַנְגִּינָה‎] see נגן‎.

II. מִנֵּי מִנִּי,‎ see מִן‎. מִנִּי‎ Psa 45:9 see I. [ מֵן‎].

מִנָיוֺת‎ see מְנָת‎ below מנה‎.

מִנְיָמִן מִנְיָמִין,‎ see מִיָּמִן‎.

מִנְלָם‎ see [ מִנְלֶה‎] below נלה‎.

מנן‎ (of following; Arabic is praecidit funem, diminuit numerum,debilitavit; also be bounteous, Qor 3:158 and elsewhere, a gift; whence ZerweckPräp. Min 4 assumes a primary meaning to separate — either from or for ("zutheilen"), as the case might be).

יועש.def:
H3135. Yoash

יוֺעָשׁ‎ proper name, masculine ᵐ5‎ Ἰωας (׳י‎ hath aided (?; compare Arabic ); compare Sabean אלעֿותֿ‎ DHM in MV) —

1 a Benjamite, son of Becher 1Chr 7:8.

2 an officer under David 1Chr 27:28.

יוֺצָדָק‎ see יְהוֺצָדָק‎.

יוֺקִים‎ see יְהוֺיָקִים‎.

יוֺרָם‎ see יְהוֺרָם‎.

יוֺשָׁפָט‎ see יְהוֺשָׁפָט‎.

יוצאת.def:
H3318. yatsa

יָצָא‎1068 verb go or come out (Late Hebrew id.; Aramaic יְעָא‎; Ethiopic , Assyrian âƒû DlHWB 237, all = go out, forth; Syriac go forth (in sense of germinate), grow; Phoenician יצא‎ march out; compare SI5 המוצא‎ the source (of water); Sabean וצַא‎ go out, DHM in MV; Arabic is be or become fair, beautiful, neat, clean, compare NöZMG 1886, 725) — Perfect יָצָא‎ Gen 10:11 92t.; 3 feminine singular יָָֽצְאָה‎ Num 16:35 13t.; יָצָ֑אָה‎ Isa 28:29; 2masculine singular יָצָאתָ‎ Gen 24:5 7t.; 2 feminine singular וְיָצָאת‎ Jer 31:4; 2masculine plural יְצָאתֶם‎ Exod 13:3; Deut 11:10 וִיצָאתֶם‎ Judg 21:21; Malachi 3:20; 3plural suffix יְצָאֻנִי‎ Jer 10:20, etc.; Imperfect יֵצֵא‎ Gen 15:4 64t.; וַיֵּצֵא‎ 4:16 132t.; 3 feminine singular תֵּצֵא‎ Exod 21:7 22t.; וַתֵּצֵא‎ Gen 30:16 14t.; 2 masculine singular תֵּצֵא‎ Deut 20:1 16t.; 3 plural יֵצְאוּ‎ Gen 15:14 +; יֵצֵ֑אוּ‎ 17:6 +; 3 feminine plural וַתֵּצֶ֫אנָה‎ 1Sam 18:6; 2Kin 2:24; וַתֵּצֶאןָ‎ Exod 15:20; 2feminine plural תֵּצֶ֫אנָה‎ Amos 4:3, etc.; Imperative צֵא‎ Gen 8:16 15t.; וָצֵ֑אָה‎ Judg 9:29; feminine singular צְאִי‎ Song 1:8; masculine plural Gen 19:14 11t.; צֵ֑אוּ‎ Isa 49:9; Ezek 9:7 + Jer 58:8 Qr (Kt יֵצֵ֑אוּ‎) צְאֶינָה‎ Song 3:11; Infinitive absolute יָצוֺא‎ Gen 8:7 2t.; יָצאֹ‎ 27:30 3t.; Infinitive construct צֵאת‎ 24:11 31t.; suffix צֵאתִי‎ Exod 9:29 3t.; צֵאתֵנוּ‎ Josh 9:12; צֵאתְךָ‎ Deut 16:3 10t., etc.; Participle יֹצֵא (יוֺצֵא)‎ Gen 2:10 62t.; feminine singular שֶׁיֹּצָא‎ Eccl 10:5; יֹצֵאת׳(יו )‎ Gen 24:15 11t.; יֹצֵת‎ Deut 28:37, etc.; —

1 go or come out or forth:

a. from (מִן‎) a place, e.g. a tent Gen 31:33 (E; opposed to בְ בּוֺא‎), מוֺעֵד אֹהֶל מִמֶּתַח‎ Lev 8:33; 10:7 (P), compare מִןהַֿמִּקְדָּשׁ‎ 21:22 (H); from a house 2Sam 11:8, the doors (דלתי‎) of a house Josh 2:19 (JE), Judg 11:31; ביתו מִפֶתח‎ Exod 12:22 (JE), from a camp 1Sam 13:17; 2Kin 7:12, a city Gen 19:14 (J), 12:4 (P), 1Kin 11:29; 20:17; Micah 4:10, a cave 1Sam 24:9, the ark Gen 9:18 (J), 8:16, 19 (both P); out of vineyards Judg 21:21; followed by accusative אֶתהָֿעִיר‎ Gen 44:4 (E), Exod 9:29 (J); with בְּ‎ also, of gate Jer 17:19; Neh 2:13; followed by accusative local. פָ֑תַח אֵצֵא לֹא‎ Job 31:34; participle construct הֵַתּבָה יֹצְאֵי‎ Gen 9:10 (P), עִירוֺ שַׁעַר יֹצְאֵי‎ 34:24 (P); absolute Josh 2:5 (JE), Judg 3:24; Exod 34:34 (P), Num 33:3 (P; Israel going out [from Egypt]), 2 h 26:20 +; specify., of going out (מִן‎) from a land (of emigration) Gen 10:11, 14; 24:5 (all J); patric. of coming forth from (the land of) Egypt (the Exodus) Exod 12:41 (J), 13:3, 8; 23:15; 34:18; Num 11:20; 22:5 (all J E), and especially D, Deut 4:45-46, 9:7; 11:10; 16:3 (twice in verse); 16:6; 23:5; 24:9; 25:17; Josh 2:10; 5:4-5, 6 (all D), Num 33:1 (P), 1Kin 6:1; 8:9 2Chr 5:10; 2Kin 21:15; Jer 7:25; Hag 2:5; Psa 114:1.

b go forth from (the presence of) a person: Exod 8:26; 9:33; 10:6 (all followed by מֵעִם‎), Gen 44:28; Exod 5:20; Jer 2:37 (מֵאֵת‎), Judg 3:19 (מֵעָלָיו‎); followed by מִלִּפְנֵי‎ Gen 4:16 (J), 41:46; 47:10; Est 8:15; Eccl 10:5; followed by מְּנֵי מֵעִם‎ Job 1:12, מְּנֵי מֵאֵת‎ 2:7; followed by suffix יְצָאֻנִי‎ Jer 10:20 (see De Eccl 7:18).

c. in technical senses: absolute go forth, of emancipation Exod 21:2-3,(twice in verse); 21:4-5, 7 (3 t. in verse); 21:11 (all J E), compare יַדאֲֿרָם מִתַּחַת יצא‎ 2Kin 13:5; of release in the year of jubilee, land, etc. Lev 25:28, 30, 31, 33 (all H), 27:21 (P); also of a debtor-slave 25:54 (H); suffix divorce מִבֵּיתוֺ וְיָָֽצְאָה‎ Deut 24:2; of condemnation רָשָׁע יֵצֵא בְּהִשָּֽׁפְטוֺ‎ Psa 109:7 when he is judged let him go out as a criminal, i.e. be condemned: of bowels (מֵעִים‎) falling out by reason of disease 2Chr 21:15, 19.

d. of flight, involving escape: followed by הַחוּ֫צָה‎, || נוּס‎, flee Gen 39:12, 15 (J), תֵצֵא נָצאֹ כִּי‎ Jer 48:9; opposed to taken (by lot) 1Sam 14:41; מִמֶּ֑נָּה לָצֵאת לֹאיֿוּכְלוּ אֲשֶׁר רָעָה‎ Jer 11:11 calamity from which they shall not be able to escape; perhaps also אֶתכֻּֿלָּם יֵצֵא אֱלֹהִים יְרֵא‎ Eccl 7:18 he that feareth God shall escape (or be freed from, see De Hi-Now Mishna) all of them (see VB), — on accusative with יצא‎ see De.

e. depart נַפְשָׁהּ בְּצֵאת‎ Gen 35:18 i.e. when she was expiring; so רוּחוֺ תֵּצֵא‎ Psa 146:4; מִנָּבָל הַיַּיִן בְּצֵאת‎ 1Sam 25:27 i.e. when Nabal became sober; also figurative לִבָּם וַיֵּצֵא‎ Gen 42:28 (E) i.e. their heart failed (|| וַיֶּחֶרְדוּ‎); rust from (מִן‎) caldron Ezek 24:16 (see Co 12:5); of glory of ׳י‎ 10:18; כָּלהֲֿדָרָהּ בַּתצִֿיּוֺן מִן וַיֵּצֵא‎ Lam 1:6; hence infinitive = exit, end הַשָּׁנָה בְּצֵאת‎ Exod 23:16 (JE), and, refundantly, שְׁנַיִם לְיָמִים הַקֵּץ צֵאת כְּעֵת‎2Chr 21:19 i.e. at the end of two years

f. of inanimate things: river out of Eden Gen 2:10 (J), water out of rock Exod 17:6 (E), Num 20:11 (JE), from Lehi Judg 15:19; of molten calf out of fire Exod 32:24(E); of gold (after refining) Job 23:10 (absolute, in simile); in prophecy of fountain from house of ׳י‎ Ezek 47:1, 8, 12; Zech 14:8; Joel 4:18; of seed (semen virile) from man Lev 15:16, 32 (P), 22:4 (H); of weapon which has pierced body 2Sam 2:23 (מֵאַחֲרָיו‎), 2Kin 9:24 (מִלִּבּוֺ‎), Job 20:25 (מִגֵּוַה‎); הַמֶּלֶךְ מַשְׂאַת אַחֲרָיו וַתֵּצֵא‎ 2Sam 11:8 and there went out ( = was sent out) after him the king's portion (i.e. the food given by the king); idiomatically of expenditure of money 2Kin 12:13 (absolute, compare Hiph`il v.12:12); of swift movement of arrow from bow Zech 9:14 (like lightning), of lightning out of fire Ezek 1:13; absolute of sunrise (subject שֶׁמֶשׁ‎) Judg 5:31 (in simile), Gen 19:23, compare Isa 13:10 (so Assyrian, e.g. ultu ƒît šanši adi êrib šanši COT Gen 19:23); of rising of stars (כּוֺכָבִים‎) Neh 4:15; of sentence of judge Hab 1:4 (twice in verse); Psa 17:2; of judgment, or right appearing (with simile of light) Hosea 6:5 (read יֵצֵא כָאוֺר וּמִשְׁמָּטִי‎), Isa 62:1; of a lot יוֺסֵף לִבְנֵי הַנּוֺרָל וַיֵּצֵא‎ Josh 16:1 (JE), and especially P, Num 33:54; Josh 19:1, 17, 24, 32, 40; 21:4, compare also גּוֺרָלָם גְּבוּל ויצא‎ 18:11 (P)

g. with especial emphasis on idea of origin, source: hyssop out of the wall 1Kin 5:13; הדבר יצא מיהוה‎ Gen 24:50 (J) from ׳י‎ has the thing proceeded, of a providential arrangement, so י ׳מֵעִם‎ Isa 28:29; רֶשַׁע יֵצֵא מֵרְשָׁעִים‎ 1Sam 24:14 (an ancient proverb); of pollution proceeding from (מֵאֵת‎) prophets Jer 23:15; of fire from Heshbon Num 21:28 (JE), Jer 48:45, compare Judg 9:15, 20 (twice in verse); of fire י ׳מִלִּפְנֵי‎ Lev 9:24; 10:2, י ׳מֵאֵת‎ Num 16:35 (all P); in theophany לְרַגְליו רֶשֶׁף יצא‎ Hab 3:5; iniquity from unreceptive heart Psa 73:7 (see I. הֵלֶב‎

1); wrath י ׳מִלִּפְנֵי‎ Num 17:11 (P); absolute Jer 4:4 = 21:12; 23:19 = 30:23; so salvation Isa 51:5; מִמֶּךָּ יָָֽצְאָה וְנִשְׁמַתמִֿי‎ Job 26:4; of words going forth from mouth of speaker (of solemn or formal speech) יֵצֵא לֹא דָּבָר מִמִּיכֶם‎ Josh 6:10 (JE), Judg 11:26; 1Sam 2:3; Jer 44:17; Job 37:2; Est 7:8, also Num 30:3; 32:24 (both P); of ׳י‎s words going forth from his mouth, or from him Isa 45:23; 48:3; 51:4; 55:11; Ezek 33:30; of ׳י‎s words, instruction, command, etc., going froth Isa 2:3 = Micah 4:2 (from Jerusalem), Dan 9:23; of human commandment Est 1:19, compare 1:17.

h. of children as going forth from loins (of father) מִמֵּעִים‎ 2Sam 7:12; 16:11; מֵחֲלָצִים‎ Gen 35:11 (P), 1Kin 8:19 2Chr 6:9; followed by מִן‎ alone 2Kin 20:18 = Isa 39:7; also יְרֵכוֺ יֹצְאֵי‎ Judg 8:30; Gen 46:26; Exod 1:5 (both P); also of birth מֵרֶחֶם‎ (אִמּוֺ‎) Num 12:12 (JE), Jer 1:5; 20:18; Job 3:11; figurative of sea 38:9; of ice 38:29; אִמּוֺ מִבֶּטֶן‎ 1:21; Eccl 5:14; literal, source not expressed, Gen 25:25-26, 38:28-29, 30 (all J); of untimely birth Exod 21:22 (JE); compare רַגְלֶיהָ מִבֵּין היּוֺצֵ֯ת‎ Deut 28:57 (|| תֵּלֵד‎); of family or race connection (followed by מִן‎) Nahum 1:11; Isa 48:1; 1Chr 1:12; 2:53; יצא‎ also of produce of vine (מִגֶּפֶן‎) Judg 13:14, compare הַשָּׂדֶה הַיֹּצֵא‎ Deut 14:22 (read ⅏ יצא‎, see Di); לֶחֶם יצא מִמֶּנָּה אֶרֶץ‎ Job 28:5; of viper proceeding from serpent's root Isa 14:29; further, with idea of unfolding, growth Job 8:16; 14:2; 31:40; יִשָׁ֑י מִגֶּזַע חֹטֶר וְיָצָא‎ Isa 11:1; of the little horn Dan 8:9; so of branches of candlestick in tabernacle Exod 25:32-33, 35; 37:18-19, 21 (all P); then simply project (tower from wall) Neh 3:25-26, 27; of measuring-line going forth (absolute) in a particular direction Jer 31:39; of a boundary (-line) going out (absolute) so as then to turn and make an angle Num 34:4, 9; Josh 15:3-4, 9, 11 (twice in verse); 16:2, 6, 7; 18:15 (twice in verse); 18:17 (twice in verse); 19:12-13, 27, 34, 47.

2. a. go forth to a place Gen 27:3 (J), Jer 14:18; Ezek 3:22; Zech 6:6 (twice in verse); 6:7 +; so הַמַּרְשְׁדֹ֫נָה וַיֵּצֵא‎ Judg 3:22 (see VB); go forth in surrender 1Sam 11:3 (followed by אֶל‎ person) 2Kin 18:31 = Isa 36:16; Jer 38:17, 21; יוֺצֵאת וְאֵין מֶּרֶץ אֵין‎ Psa 144:14; into captivity בַּגּוֺלָה אִתְּכֶם יָָֽצְאוּ לֹא‎ Jer 29:16, compare 48:7; Zech 14:2; also הַזֶּה מִןהַֿמָּקוֺם יָצָא‎ Jer 22:11, compare יְצָאֻנִי בָּנַי‎ 10:20.

b. go forward proceed to or toward something, figurative, יָצָ֑אוּ רָעָה אֶלֿ מֵרָעָה‎ Jer 9:2 from evil to evil they go on; in like manner 2Sam 20:8 si vera lectio, but read rather יָָֽצְאָה וְהִיא‎ and it (i.e. the sword) came out (of the sheath) and fell ᵐ5‎ We Dr Kit Bu.

c. come or go forth, with especially reference to purpose or result: וְהִכִּתִיו אַחֲרָיו וְיָצָאתִי‎ 1Sam 17:35, compare 24:15; נַפְשׁוֺ לְבַקֵּשׁ שָׁאוּל יָצָא‎ 23:15, compare 26:20, further 2Sam 2:13; 18:4; 1Kin 20:18 (twice in verse); 20:19, 39; 2Kin 5:2; Micah 1:11; Jer 37:5; Zech 14:3; Dan 11:11, 44 +; of an adulteress Prov 7:15; of an angel Num 22:32 (JE), Dan 9:22; for אִתְּכֶם ֗֗֗ יֵצֵא‎ 1Sam 22:3 (let my father etc.go forth [to be] with you, compare Klo) read perhaps יֵשְׁבוּ‎ as ᵑ9 ᵑ6‎ Kit, see also Dr; of army marching out to form battle line אֶלהַֿמַּעֲרָכָה יֹצֵא‎ 17:20 (with article, ᵑ0‎, < omitted by We Dr Kit Bu); יָָֽצְאוּ אֲשֶׁר בְּכֹל‎ Judg 2:15 in all to which they went forth, לפני יָצָא‎ 1Sam 8:20 of king going out at the head of his soldiers; so of ׳י‎ before his people Judg 4:14; 2Sam 5:24; Psa 68:8, compare 108:12; 1Chr 14:15; of ׳י‎ going out from Seir Judg 5:14, compare Hab 3:13; of the hand of ׳י‎, in hostility יַדיֿ בִי ׳יָָֽצְאָה‎ Ruth 1:13; absolute of fire breaking out Exod 22:5 (JE).

3 of combinations, note esp.: וָשׁוֺב יָצוֺא‎ (infinitive absolute) Gen 8:7 going out and returning, nearly = to and fro; וּמְקַלֵּל יָצוֺא יֹצֵא ֗֗֗ יוֺצֵא אִישׁ‎ 2Sam 16:5 = coming forth, cursing as he came; ובא יצא‎, literal בָּא וְאֵין יוֺצֵא אֵין‎ Josh 6:1 none went out and none came in, i.e. there was no free egress or ingress (of besieged city), compare 1Kin 15:17 2Chr 16:1; 15:5; to go out and come in before, of leader in war Num 27:17; 1Sam 18:16, compare 29:6; figurative Deut 28:6 blessed shalt thou be ובצאתך בבואך‎, i.e. when thou completest and beginnest any undertaking, so 28:19; 31:2 ולבוא לצאת אוכל לא‎, i.e. I can no more engage in active undertakings; similarly Josh 14:11; 1Kin 3:7; Isa 37:28 ( + שִׁבְתְּךָ‎) = 2Kin 19:27; Psa 121:8.

יחד.def:
H3162. yachad

יַ֫חַד‎45 noun [masculine] unitedness. 1 as substantive only 1Chr 12:17 (peculiar) לֳי֑חַד לֵבָב עֲלֵיכֶֹם יִהְיֶהלִּֿי‎ I will have a heart toward you for unitedness, i.e. my heart shall be ready to become one with yours (compare v.12:38 אחד לב‎).

2 elsewhere always in accusative as

adverb in union, together (compare Arabic in accusative with suffix in his solitariness = alone) —

a. together, of community in action, place, or time (often combined, but one usually more prominent than the others); (1) in action, Job 38:7 אֵל כּוֺכְבֵי בְּרָןיַֿחַד‎ when the stars of God shouted together; Ezra 4:3 we together will build (opposed to you), with נִלְחַם‎ 1Sam 17:10, נִשְׁמַּט‎ Isa 43:26; (2) in place 1Sam 11:11 יָ֑חַד שׁנים בם נשׁארו ולא‎; 2Sam 10:15 יָחַ֑ד וַיֵּאָֽסְפוּ‎ Psa 2:2; 31:14; 88:18Psalm 1יַחַד שֶׁבֶת‎ Isa 50:8, as predicate Micah 2:12 אֲשִׂימֶנּוּ יַחַד‎; (3) in place and time at once. 2Sam 21:9 יָ֑חַד וַיִּמְּלוּ‎ and they perished together, 14:16 to destroy יחד בני ואת אתי‎; (4) of time alone (poetry) Isa 42:14 יחד וְאֶשְׁאַף אֶשֹּׁם‎ I will gasp and pant together, 45:8; Job 6:2; 17:16 **read נֵחָ֑ת‎ for יַחַ֑ת‎; יַחַד‎ here will then belong to (1).; Psa 141:10 אעבור עד אנכי יחד‎ while I at the same time pass on.

b. all together, altogether (poetic synonym of כֻּלָּם‎ but more forcible, suggesting often, especially with כל‎, all at once, as well as altogether), Isa 44:11 יחד יבשׁו יפחדו‎ (compare Psa 40:15), 62:10 יַחַד מֵהֶבֶל הֵמָּה‎ they are all together (made) of vanity, Isa 22:3 יחד נדדו קציניך כל‎ (with כל‎ also Psa 41:8; Job 34:15): often in poetry beginning a clause with emphasis, Deut 33:5; Job 3:18 שׁאננו אסירים יחד‎ 16:10; 19:12 גדודיו יבאו יחד‎, 24:4; 31:38; Psa 41:8; 98:8; Hosea 11:7 (with a negative), 11:8; in connection with a suffix, or object of a verb, Isa 27:4 יָ֑חַד אציתנה‎ I will burn it altogether, Psa 33:15 לִבָּם יַחַד הַיֹּצֵר‎ who formeth the hearts of them all together, 74:6; 74:8; Job 10:8 סָבִיב יַחַד‎ altogether round about (but read perhaps with ᵑ6 ᵐ5‎ Del Di תִסּוֺב אַחַר‎), 40:13.

c. together, in the sense of alike, the one as well as the other, Psa 49:3; 49:11 יאבדו ובער כסיל יחד‎ Job 21:26; 34:29. More frequent is

יַחְדָּו‎92 (Jer 46:12, 21; 49:3 יַחְדָּיו‎),

adverb together (properly (in) his or its unitednesses (compare Arabic alone; and for the form אַשְׁרָיו‎), but, the origin of the term. being forgotten, applied Generally as an adverb, without regard to number, Gender, or person: so Ges Ol§ 135c Sta§ 370a) — together:

a. of community in action, Psa 34:4 יחדו שׁמו ונרוממה‎ let us exalt his name together, Isa 52:9, with נוֺעַץ‎ take counsel, 45:21; Psa 71:10; 83:6; Neh 6:7; נִצָּה‎ to struggle Deut 25:11; in place, as with ישׁב‎ Gen 13:6; Deut 25:5, הלך‎ Gen 22:6, 8; Amos 3:3, בוא‎ Jer 3:18; Job 9:32, קרב‎ Isa 41:1, נפל‎ 2Sam 2:16, אכל‎ Judg 19:6; Jer 41:1, התקבץ‎ Josh 9:2, נאסף‎ Judg 6:33, etc.; Deut 22:10 יחדו ובחמור בשׁור‎ coupling pairs, and so strengthening וְ‎ (mostly in poetry), 22:11; Amos 1:15 יחדו ושׂריו הוא‎ (compare Jer 48:7 Qr [Kt יחד‎], 49:3) 6:11-12, י ונשׁים ׳שׂדות‎, 6:21 (accents), 13:14; 31:8, 13; 50:4, 33; Isa 41:19, compare 65:7; in time (rare: but see below), Psalm 4:9 in peace ואישׁן אשׁכבה יחדו‎ will I at once lie down and sleep (i.e. lie down and fall asleep immediately).

b. emphatic (especially in poetry) = all together 1Sam 31:6; Isa 10:8 מלכים יחדו שׂרי הלא‎ are not my princes all together, all alike, kings? 18:6; 40:5; 41:20, 23; 45:16 (|| כֻּלָּם‎), 46:2 יחדו כרעו קרסו‎, 48:13; 66:17; Psa 14:3 (|| הַכֹּל‎), 19:10 יחדו צדקו‎ (of J.'s ordinances), 35:26; 37:38; sometimes (like יַחַד‎

b) suggesting all at once, as well as all together, Exod 19:8 יחדו העם כל ויענו‎ (so, with כל‎, Isa 22:3; 31:3; Zech 10:4), Isa 1:28, 31 יחדו שׁניהם ובערו‎. Prefixed to a clause (like יחד‎), Deut 33:17 (compare יחד‎ 33:5), Isa 9:20; 11:7, 14; 31:3; 43:17; 45:16; 52:8; Jer 46:12; 51:38; Lam 2:8; Job 24:17 (strengthening לָמוֺ‎)

c. alike, the one as well as the other, Deut 12:22 (= 15:22) the unclean and the clean alike may eat it, 1Sam 30:24 יַחֲלֹקוּ׃ יַחְדָּו‎ they shall share together, i.e. alike.

Pi`el Perfect3feminine singular suffix יֶחֱמַתְנִי‎ Psa 51:7 in sin my mother conceived me (|| חוֺלָ֑לְתִּי‎); Infinitive construct of heat of cattle in breeding, conception; בְּכָליַֿחֵם‎ Gen 30:41 at every breeding-heat of the flock (J); יַחֵם בְּעֵת‎ 31:10 at the time of the flock's being hot in breeding (E); suffix 3 feminine plural לְיַחֲמֶנָּה‎ 30:41 in order that they might have breeding-heat (J).

יחמור.def:
H3180. yachmur

יַחְמוּר‎ noun [masculine] roebuck (Samaritan יחמור‎, Syriac יַחְמוּרָא ᵑ7‎ see HomNS 392 (and 339), LagBN 127; name from reddish colour ?) — edible Deut 14:5; 1Kin 5:3; — on identification with roebuck, see TristrProc. Zool. Soc. London, May 2, 1876 ConderTent Work, 1887, p.91.

I. חמשׁ‎ (√ of following; meaning unknown).

יחמי.def:
H3181. Yachmay

יַחְמַי‎ proper name, masculine (perhaps= יַחְמְיָה‎ may ׳י‎ protect ! compare Sabean יחמאל‎ Hal187) — a man of Issachar 1Chr 7:2, ᵐ5‎ Ειικαν, A Ιεμου, ᵐ5‎L Ιαμιν.

יחף.def:
H3182. yacheph

יָחֵף‎ adjective barefoot, always absolute יָחֵף‎ Isa 20:2 4t.; — וְיָחֵף עָרוֺם הלך‎ 20:2 (מֵעַל תַחֲלֹץ נַעַלְךָ רַגְּלֶ֑ךָ‎ in preceding clause), 20:3; יָחֵף הֹלֵךְ‎ 2Sam 15:30; יָחֵף נָהַג‎ Isa 20:3; apparently = substantive, מִיָּחֵף רַגְלֵךְ מִנְעִי‎ Jer 2:25 withhold thy foot from bareness (Syriac discalceatio).

יַחְצְאֵלִי יַחֲצִיאֵל, יַחְצְאֵל,‎ see below חצה‎.

יחצאל.def:
H3183. Yachtseel

יַחְצִיאֵל יַחְצְאֵל,‎ proper name, masculine (God divideth, apportioneth) — son of Naphtali; ׳יַחְצְ‎ Gen 46:24 (ᵐ5‎ Ασιηλ, ᵐ5‎L Ιασνηλ), Num 26:48 (Σαηλ, Ασιηλ) = ׳יַחֲצִי‎ 1Chr 7:13 (Ιεισιηλ, ᵐ5‎L Ιασσιηλ).

יחצאלי.def:
H3184. Yachtseeli

יַחְצְאֵלִי‎ adjective, of a people of foregoing; only with article as proper name collective, Num 26:48.

יחש.def:
H3188. yachas

יַ֫חַשׁ‎ noun [masculine] genealogy (Late Hebrew יִחוּס יַחַס‎ Aramaic יִחוּס‎) — הַיַּ֫חַשׂ סֵפֶר‎ Neh 7:5 book of Genealogy.

יחת.def:
H3189. Yachath

יַ֫חַת‎ proper name, masculine (perhaps for יַחֲתֶה יַחְתֶּה,‎ he (God) will snatch up) —

1 grandson of Judah 1Chr 4:2 (twice in verse), ᵐ5‎ Ιεθ, ᵐ5‎L Ιαωθ.

2 Levites:

a. 1Chr 6:5; 6:28, ᵐ5‎ Ιεεθ, ᵐ5‎L Ιααθ.

b. 1Chr 23:10-11, ᵐ5‎ Ιεθ, ᵐ5‎L Ιειηλ.

c. 1Chr 24:22, ᵐ5‎ Ιναθ, ᵐ5‎L Ιααθ.

d.2Chr 34:12, ᵐ5‎ Ιε(θ), ᵐ5‎L Ιαεθ.

יטב.def:
H3190. yatab

[יָטַב‎] verb be good, well, glad, pleasing (Aramaic יְטַב‎ Zinjirli יטב‎ DHMSendsch. 57) —

Qal (Perfect not in use, see טוֺב‎

verb) Imperfect יִיטַב‎ Gen 12:13 34t., יִטַב‎ 1Sam 24:5 3t.; תִּיטַב‎ Est 2:4 2t.; תֵּיטְבִי‎ (incorrect for תִּיטְבִי‎ Ges§ 70 R) Nahum 3:8; plural יִיטְבוּ‎ Gen 34:18; for Infinitive and Participle see טוֺב‎ —

1 be glad, joyful, לֵב‎ Judg 18:20; 19:6, 9; 1Kin 21:7; Ruth 3:7; Eccl 7:3.

2 be well placed, אָמוֺן מִנּאֹ הֲתֵיטְבִי‎ Nahum 3:8 art thou better placed than No of Amon?

3 impersonal with לְ‎, be well for or with, go well with Gen 12:13 (J), 40:14 (E), Deut 4:40; 5:16, 26; 6:3, 18; 12:25, 28; 22:7; 2Kin 25:24; Ruth 3:1; Jer 7:23; 38:20; 40:9; 42:6.

4 be pleasing בְּעֵינֵי‎ Gen 34:18 (J), 41:37; 45:16 (E), Deut 1:23; Lev 10:19-20, Josh 22:30, 33 (P), 1Sam 18:5; 24:5; 2Sam 3:36; 18:4; 1Kin 3:10; Est 1:21; 2:4 (twice in verse); 2:9; with לְ‎, be pleasing to, Psa 69:32; with לִפְנֵי‎ (late) Neh 2:5-6, Est 5:14.

Hiph`il Perfect הֵיטִיב‎ Gen 12:16; Josh 24:20; הֵיטִב‎ 1Sam 25:31; suffix הֵיטִ֑בְךָ‎ Deut 30:5; הֵיטַבְתָּ‎ Jer 1:12; הֵיטַבְתְּ‎ Ruth 3:10, etc.; וְהִֵטבֹתִ֫י‎ Ezek 36:11 (for הֵיטַבְתִּי‎ as if from טוב‎ Ges§ 70R); Imperfect יֵיטִיב‎ Num 10:32 3t.; יֵיטִב‎ Prov 15:13 2t.; יְיֵטִיב‎ Job 24:21 (Ges§ 70R); יֵיטֵיב‎ 1Kin 1:47 (Ges§ 70R); וַיִּ֫יטֶב‎ Exod 1:20; suffix וִיטִיבְךָ‎ Eccl 11:9, etc.; Imperative הֵיטִ֫יבָה‎ Psalm 51:20; הֵיטִ֫יבִי‎ Isa 23:16, etc.; Infinitive absolute הֵיטֵיב‎ Jer 7:5; 10:5; הֵיטֵב‎ Gen 32:13 10t.; Infinitive construct הֵיטִיב‎ Lev 5:4 7t.; הֵטִיב‎ Jer 32:41; suffix הֵיטִיבִי‎ 32:40, etc.; Participle מֵיטִיב‎ 1Sam 16:17; מֵטִיב‎ Psa 119:68; מֵטִב‎ Ezek 33:32, etc.; —

1 make glad, rejoice לֵב‎ Judg 19:22; פנים‎ Prov 15:13; the person Eccl 11:9.

2 do good to, deal well with, a person usually with preposition: with לְ‎, Exod 1:20; Josh 24:20 (both E), Gen 12:16; Num 10:29, 32 (all J), Judg 17:13; 1Sam 25:31; Psa 49:19; 125:4; with עִם‎, Gen 32:10; 32:13 (twice in verse); Num 10:32 (all J), Micah 2:7; with accusative Deut 8:16; 28:63; 30:5; 1Sam 2:32; Jer 18:10; 32:40-41, Zech 8:15; Job 24:21; Psalm 51:20; absolute Ezek 36:11; opposed to הֵרַע‎ (in prov. phrase, cannot do good or ill, = cannot do anything at all; test of deity) Zeph 1:12; Isa 41:23; Jer 10:5.

3 do well or thoroughly: דבּרוּ (כל)אשׁר הֵטִיבוּ‎ they have done well (all) that they have spoken Deut 5:25; 18:17; להיטיב כפים הרע על‎ Micah 7:3 their hands are upon the evil to do it well,i.e.diligently, thoroughly, literally make (it) good, with play on הרע‎; especially as auxil. followed by infinitive; ׳היט דעת‎ Prov 15:2 = know well; לראות‎ Jer 1:12 see well; (לְ)נַגֵּן‎ play well, skilfully 1Sam 16:17; Isa 23:16; Ezek 33:32; Psa 33:3; compare participle construct followed by substantive צָ֑עַד מֵטִבֵי‎ Prov 30:29 marching well, in a stately manner, so לֶכֶת מֵיטִבֵי‎ 30:29; infinitive absolute הֵיטֵיב‎ as adverb = thoroughly, with verbs: כתת‎ Deut 9:21, שׁאל‎ 13:15, דרשׁ‎ 17:4; 19:18, באר‎ 27:8, שׁבּר‎ 2Kin 11:18.

4 make a thing good, right, beautiful: with accusative of thing: the head 2Kin 9:30; dress, trim: a lamp Exod 30:7 (P); מַצֵּבוֺת‎ Hosea 10:1; גֵּהָה‎ Prov 17:22 a glad heart maketh a good cure; followed by מִן‎ comparative, object שֵׁם‎ 1Kin 1:47 ( = make it more glorious then); חֶסֶד‎ Ruth 3:10; followed by דֶּרֶךְ‎ = course of life or action Jer 2:33 (in order to win love); amend one's ways and doings 7:3; 18:11; 26:13; 35:15; אתדֿ תֵּיטִיבוּ ׳הֵיטֵיב‎ 7:5.

5 do well, right, ethically, absolute:

a. of men, Gen 4:7 (twice in verse) (J), Lev 5:4 (P), Psa 36:4; Isa 1:17; Jer 4:22; 13:23.

b. of God, מֵטִיב טוֺב‎ good and doing good Psa 119:68; so infinitive absolute as adverb לך חָרָה הַהֵיטֵב‎ Jonah 4:4, 9 art thou rightly angry ? followed by לי‎ 4:9. In אֶלאָֿבִי כִּייֵֿיטִב‎ 1Sam 20:13 verb is apparently intransitive, =

Qal, if it be pleasing unto my father, but

Hiph`il not elsewhere in this sense; point rather יִיטַב‎; on this and on following אֶתֿ‎ see We Dr.

יטבה.def:
H3192. Yotbah

יָטְבָה‎ proper name, of a location (pleasantness) city probably in Judah 2Kin 21:19, site unknown.

יטבתה.def:
H3193. Yotbathah

יָטְבָ֫תָה‎ proper name, of a location (pleasantness) station of Israel in wilderness Num 33:33-34, (P), Deut 10:7, site unknown.

יטור.def:
H3195. Yetur

יְטוּר‎ proper name, masculine and

of a people (perhaps connected etymologically with טִירָה‎ see Gen 25:16) — a 'son' of Ishmael 25:15 = 1Chr 1:31 +? 5:19; Ἰτουραῖοί τε καὶ Ἄραβες Straboxvi, 2, 18, Ἰτουραίους JosephAnt. xiii. 11, 3 ed. Niese; they gave name to their region, which was, substantially, Anti-Lebanon, compare τῆς Ἰτουραίας καὶ Τραχωνίτιδος χώρας Luke 3:1; on יְטוּר‎ and (later) proper name, of a territory Ituraea, see especially GASmGeogr. 544 ff. and reff.

מוֺתָר‎ noun masculineProv 14:23 abundance, pre-eminence; —

1 abundance, plenty מוֺתָ֑ר‎ Prov 14:23; 21:5 (in both opposed to מַחְסוֺר‎).

2 pre-eminence, superiority, אָ֔יִן מִןהַֿבְּהֵמָה הָאָדָם מוֺתַר‎ Eccl 3:19 the superiority of man over beast is nothing.

יין.def:
H3196. yayin

יַ֫יִן‎141 noun masculinePsa 75:9 wine (Late Hebrew id.; Ethiopic : vitis, vinea, vinum; Arabic (black) grapes, see HomZMG 1889, 654; Sabean וין‎ vineyard, MordtZMG 1887, 364 Homl.c. 659 (both after Glaser); Assyrian inu in vocabularies, but this loan-word from western Shemites, according to HomAufsätze 102; JenZA i, 186 f., ZMG 1890, 705 argues to the contrary) — absolute יַ֫יִן‎ Gen 9:21 84t.; יָ֑יִן‎ 14:18 33t.; construct יַ֫יִן‎ Psa 60:5; Song 8:2; יֵין‎ Deut 32:18 9t.; suffix יֵינִי‎ Song 5:1, etc.; — wine:

a. common drink, for refreshment Gen 14:18 (E?) 27:25 (J), Judg 19:19; 2Sam 16:2; Amos 5:11; 9:14; Hosea 14:8; Job 1:13, 18; Dan 1:5 +, tonic Prov 31:6; article of commerce Ezek 27:18; Neh 13:15; among supplies in strongholds 2Chr 11:11; as making merry 2Sam 13:28; Zech 9:15; 10:7; Est 1:10; Eccl 9:7; 10:19; Psa 104:15.

b. used for rejoicing before ׳י‎ Deut 14:26, compare Hosea 9:4; as drink-offering in prescribed ritual Exod 29:40; Lev 23:13; Num 15:5, 7, 10; 28:14; among temple stores 1Chr 9:29; used also in heathen ceremonial, see Deut 32:33.

c. intoxicating 1Sam 1:14; 25:37; Gen 9:21, 24; 19:32-33, 34, 35 (all J), Isa 5:11, 22; Prov 21:17; 23:30-31, +; || תִּירוֺשׁ‎ Hosea 4:11; || שֵׁכָר‎ 1Sam 1:15; Micah 2:11; Isa 24:9; 28:7 (twice in verse); 56:12 12t.; forbidden to Nazirites Num 6:3 (twice in verse) (שֵׁכָר וְחֹמֶץ יַיִן חֹמֶץ‎), 6:4; 6:20, compare Amos 2:12; to Rechabites Jer 35:2, 5f.; to mother of Samson Judg 13:4, 7, 14; to priests entering sanctuary Lev 10:9 (P), Ezek 44:21; unfitting for kings Prov 31:4.

d. combinations are: הַטּוֺב יֵין‎ Cant 7:10 = the best wine (read כַּיַּיִן‎ ?) Ges§ 133. 3, R. 1; מַלְכוּת יֵין‎ Est 1:7 royal wine; יַּיִן אֹצרְוֺת‎ 1Chr 27:27 stores of wine, wine-supply; הָרֶקַח יַיִן‎ Song 8:2 spiced wine; הַיַּיִן מִשְׁתֵּה‎ wine-feast Est 5:6; 7:2, 7, 8; יַיִן סֹבְאֵי‎ Prov 23:20 wine-bibbers; יין נאֹד‎ wine-skin Josh 9:4, 13; 1Sam 16:20; יין נֵבֶל‎ id. 1:24; 10:3; 25:18; 2Sam 16:1; Jer 13:12 (twice in verse); הַיָּ֑יִן בֵּית‎ Song 2:4 either wine-house, where wine is drunk, feasting-house (De and others), or place of wine = vineyard (Ew and others; compare יַיִן גֶּפֶן‎ Num 6:4).

e. metaphor of wisdom's drink Prov 9:2, 5, compare Isa 55:1; of ׳י‎s wrath Jer 25:15 (היין כּוֺס‎); of confusion sent by תַּרְעֵלָה יַיִן ׳י,‎ wine of reeling Psa 60:5, compare 75:9; of ׳י‎s awaking for vengeance, like a wine-shouter 78:65; of Babylon's fierce power Jer 51:7; of love Song 5:1; חֲמָסִים יֵין‎ Prov 4:17; in simile of one bursting with words Job 32:19; of disheartened prophet Jer 23:9 (עֲבָרוֺיַיִן כְּגֶבֶר‎); of lover's mouth Cant 7:10 (see above); love is better than wine Cant 1:2; 4:10.

יכוניה.def:
H3204. Yekonyah

or Yekonyahu or Yekoneyah יְכוֺנְיָה‎ proper name, masculine (׳י‎ is firm, enduring); — Jer 27:20 = יְכָנְ֫יָהוּ‎ 24:1 = יְכָנְיָה‎ 28:4; 29:2; 1Chr 3:16-17, Est 2:6 = כָּנְיָ֫הוּ‎ Jer 22:24, 28; 37:1 (ᵐ5‎ Ιεχονιας throughout), all of last king but one of Judah, see יְהוֺיָכִין‎ above

יכח.def:
H3198. yakach

[יָכַח‎] verb Hiph`il decide, adjudge, prove, (Late Hebrew Pi`el וִכַּח‎ argue with (עם‎), compare Hithpa`el, Hiph`il prove, correct; Aramaic Pa וַכַּח‎ Aph`el אוֺכַח‎, id.) —

Hiph`il Perfect הוֺכִיחַ‎ Isa 2:4-5t.; הֹכִיחַ‎ Gen 24:44; הוֺכִחַ‎ 21:25; 2masculine singular חֹכַחְתָּ‎ 24:14; 1singular suffix הוֺכַחְתִּיו‎ 2Sam 7:14; Imperfect יוֺכִיחַ‎ Isa 11:3 5t.; יוֺכַח‎ Hosea 4:4 4t.; יוֺכָ֑ח‎ 1Chr 12:17; suffix יוֺכִיחֵנִי‎ Psa 141:5 12t. Imperfect; Imperative הוֺכַח‎ Prov 9:8; Infinitive absolute הוֺכֵחַ‎ Lev 19:17 5t.; construct הוֺכִיחַ‎ Hab 1:12; הַלְהוֺכַח‎ Job 6:26; Participle מוֺכִיחַ‎ Ezek 3:26 8t.; plural מוֺכִיחִים‎ Prov 24:25; —

1 decide, judge, absolute Gen 31:42 (E), 1Chr 12:17; Isa 11:3; Psa 94:10; with לְ‎ decide for Isa 2:4 = Micah 4:3; Isa 11:4; with בּין‎, Gen 31:37 (E), Job 9:33; אֱלוֺהַּ עִם לְגֶבֶר‎ 16:21.

2 adjudge, appoint, with לְ‎, Gen 24:14, 44 (J).

3 shew to be right, prove, with accusative of thing and על‎ person against Job 19:5; with אל‎ person unto 13:15; so argue before 13:3, and (absolute) 15:3.

4 convince, convict, with accusative of person Psa 50:21 בּ‎ person Prov 30:6; with לְ‎ person Job 32:12.

5 reprove, chide:

a. of God, with accusative of person Job 22:4; Psa 50:8; 105:14 = 1Chr 16:21; with בּ‎ object 2Kin 19:4 = Isa 37:4.

b. of man, absolute Hosea 4:4; Ezek 3:26; Job 6:25 (twice in verse); Prov 24:25; 25:12; בַּשַּׁעַר מוֺכִיחַ‎ Amos 5:10; Isa 29:21; with accusative of person Gen 21:25 (E), Lev 19:17 (twice in verse) (H), Prov 9:8; 28:23; Jer 2:19; אֱלוהַּ מוֺכִיחַ‎ Job 40:2; accusative of thing 6:26; with לְ‎, Prov 9:7-8, 15:12; 19:25.

6 correct, rebuke, of God, absolute Hab 1:12; with accusative of person Psa 141:5; Job 13:10 (twice in verse); בְּשֵׁבֶט‎ 2Sam 7:14; happy the man whom God corrects Job 5:17; for God loves him Prov 3:12; God is entreated not to correct in anger Psa 6:2; 38:2.

Hoph`al Perfect בְּמַכְאוֺב וְהוּכַח‎ he is chastened also with pain Job 33:19.

Niph`al Imperfect וְנִוָָּֽכְחָה לְכוּנָֿא‎ Isa 1:18 come now and let us reason together; Participle עִמּוֺ נוֺכָח יָשָׁר שָׁם‎ Job 23:7 there an upright man might reason with him; feminine (passive) וְנֹכָ֑חַת‎ Gen 20:16 (E), but Di SS read וְנֹכַחַתְּ‎2feminine singular Perfect and thou art set right, righted, justified.

Hithpa`el Imperfect יִתְוַכָּח עִםוִֿשְׂרָאֵל‎ Micah 6:2 with Israel he will argue (|| לי ׳רִיב עִם‎).

יכין.def:
H3199. Yakin

יָכִין‎ proper name, masculine (he will establish); —

1 a Simeonite Gen 46:10 = Exod 6:15; Num 26:12, ᵐ5‎ Ιαχειμ(ν).

2 name of right-hand pillar before temple 1Kin 7:21 2Chr 3:17, ᵐ5‎ Ιαχουμ (opposed to בֹּעַז‎, q. v. f. above; see also RSSemitic i, 191 (208)).

יכיני.def:
H3200. Yakini

יָכִינִי‎ adjective, of a people of יָכִין‎

1, with article as collective noun ׳הַיּ‎ Num 26:12.

יכל.def:
H3201. yakol

יָכוֺל יָכֹל,‎193

verb be able, have power prevail, endure (Late Hebrew id.; Aramaic יְכִיל‎; Assyrian akâlu, Hpt in KAT2Gloss i,) —

Qal Perfect יָכֹל‎ Gen 32:26 8t.; יָכוֺל‎ 1Sam 4:15 2t.; 3 feminine singular יָכְלָה‎ Gen 36:7; Exod 2:3; 2masculine singular וְיָכָלְתָּ֫‎ 18:23; 1singular יָכֹלְתִּי‎ Gen 30:8 2t.; suffix יְכָלְתִּיו‎ Psa 13:5; 3plural יָכְ֑לוּ‎ Gen 13:6 27t. + Josh 15:63 Qr; יָכֹ֑לוּ‎ Exod 8:14 2t.; Imperfect3masculine singular יוּכָל‎ Gen 13:16 34t.; יוּכָ֑ל‎ Job 4:2 4t.; וַיֻּכָ֑ל‎ Hosea 12:5; 3feminine singular תּוּכַל‎ Amos 7:10 2t.; 2 masculine singular תּוּכַל‎ Gen 15:5 16t.; 1 singular אוּכַל‎ 19:19 30t., etc. (on these Imperfect forms as irregular Qal, see Ges§ 2, R. 3 Köi. 407 WSG 237; others

Hoph`al); Infinitive construct יְכֹ֫לֶת‎ Num 14:16; Deut 9:28; Infinitive absolute יָכוֺל‎ Num 13:20; 2Chr 32:13; יָכֹל‎ Num 22:38; 1Sam 26:25; P 8 t. (not Leviticus), Ezekiel 3 t.; often J E D Jeremiah, Isa2, not seldom in Samuel Kings Chronicles; —

1 be able, to do a thing, whether ability be physical, moral, constitutional, or dependent on external authority; usually of man Gen 13:16 (J) +, but also of gods 2Chr 32:13, 15, and of ׳י‎ Num 14:16 (JE), Deut 9:28; Jer 44:22; occasionally of inanimate things Amos 7:10; Gen 36:7 (P), Song 8:7; Eccl 1:15 (twice in verse), etc.:

a. usually followed by infinitive with לְ‎ (122 t.), Gen 31:35 I am not able to rise up; 45:1 Joseph was not able to restrain himself, 45:3; 48:10; Exod 7:21, 24 were not able to drink, 12:39; Josh 24:19 (all E); Gen 13:16 if a man can number the dust, 19:19, 22; 43:32; 44:22, 26 (twice in verse); Exod 10:5; 19:23 (all J), Gen 15:5; Exod 15:23; Num 11:14 (all J E) + 10 t. J E; Deut 7:17 10t. D; Gen 13:6 they could not dwell together, 34:14; 36:7; Exod 9:11; 40:35; Num 9:6; Josh 9:19 (all P); 1Sam 3:2; 6:20; 1Kin 9:21 (on || 2Chr 8:8 and text of Judg 1:19 see BuRS 8), Amos 7:10; Hosea 5:13; Zeph 1:18; Jer 6:10; 11:11; 13:23; 18:6; 19:11 +.

b. followed by infinitive without לְ‎ (27 t.; not P): Gen 37:4; Exod 2:3; 18:18, 23 (all E), Gen 24:50; 44:1 (J), Num 22:37-38, (JE), Deut 1:9; 7:22; 14:24; 22:29; Judg 8:3; Jer 49:10, 23; Hab 1:13; Isa 46:2; 47:11-12, 57:20; Lam 1:14; Psa 18:39; Psalm 36:13; 78:20; Prov 30:21; Job 4:2; 33:5.

c. with infinitive implicit, always negative, Gen 29:8 go and feed them; and they said, We are not able, cannot (J), Exod 8:14 (P), Isa 29:11; Jer 20:9; Psa 21:12; Jonah 1:13.

d. with negative = may not (of moral inability): Gen 43:32 (J) the Egyptians might not eat bread with the Hebrews; Judg 21:18 we may not give them wives; especially D, Deut 7:22; 12:17; 14:24; 16:5; 17:15; 22:3; 28:27, 35.

e. be able, followed by imperfect: נַכֶּה אוּכַל אוּלַי‎ Num 22:6 (JE) perchance I am able (so that) we smite (see Di; read perhaps נוּכַל‎ for אוּכַל‎ Ges§ 120, 1 b); יִגְּעוּ יוּכְלוּ לֹא‎ Lam 4:14 they are unable, they touch = are unable to touch (Dr§ 163, Obs.)

f. be able, followed by perfect consecutive, only very late, וְרָאִיתִי אוּכַל‎ Est 8:6 (twice in verse), literally how shall I be able and see? — Also in various combinations where English idiom would make it an auxiliary to another verb:

g. able to gain, accomplish: followed by acc נִקָּיוֺן יוּכְלוּ לֹא‎ Hosea 8:5 how long will they be unable (to gain) innocence? תּוּכָ֑ל כִּיכֹֿל יָדַעְתִּ֯‎ Job 42:2 I know that thou art able (to do) all things; דָּבָר אֶתְכֶם יוּכַל הַמֶּלֶךְ אֵין‎ Jer 38:5 the king is not (one who is) able (to do) anything with (אֶתְכם‎ for אִתְּכֶם‎ see Gf, i.e. against) you.

h. able to endure: וַעֲצָרָה אָוֶן אוּכַל לֹא‎ Isa 1:13 I cannot endure iniquity and (with) a solemn assembly, Psa 101:5.

i. able to reach, followed by לְ‎, Psa 139:6 it is high, לָהּ אוּכַל לֹא‎ I cannot (reach) to it.

2 prevail:

a. absolute prevail, overcome, be victor Gen 30:8 (E), 32:29 (J), Hosea 12:5; 1Sam 26:25; 1Kin 22:22 2Chr 18:21; Jer 20:7, 11; of waves 5:22; succeed Isa 16:12; Jer 3:5 (VB hast had they way).

b. followed by לְ‎ person, prevail against, over Gen 32:26 (J), Num 13:30 (JE), Judg 16:5; 1Sam 17:9; Jer 1:19; 15:20; 20:10; 38:22; Obadiah 7; Psa 129:2; Est 6:13.

c. once with suffix, יְכָלְתִּיו‎ Psa 13:5 I have prevailed over him, + Zech 9:15 (where read וְיָכְלוּם‎ for וְאָֽכְלוּ‎ with ᵑ7 ᵐ5‎ KloThLZ 1879. 564 StaZAW 1881, 18).

3 absolute have ability, strength, only negative אוּכָ֑ל לֹא מִשְּׂאֵתוֺ‎ Job 31:23 because of his loftiness I have no ability, am inadequate (to anything).

ים.def:
H3220. yam

יָם‎390 noun masculineExod 14:27 sea (Phoenician ים‎; Arabic ; Palmyrene בימא‎ on the sea, VogNo. 79; on Assyrian iâmu, (¹mu), sea, see DlHWB 307 M-ACD 52 HptBAS i. 171 n.) — absolute יָם‎ 1Sam 13:5 +; יָ֫מָּה‎ Gen 28:14 +; construct יָם‎ 14:3 23t., also סוּף יָ֫מָּה‎ Exod 10:19, but always יַםסֿוּף‎ 13:18 22t.; suffix יַמָּהּ‎ Jer 51:36; plural יַמִּים‎ Judg 5:17 29t.; — sea: especially

1 Mediterranean Num 13:29 (E), 34:5 (P), Deut 1:7; Josh 5:1; 1 Kings 5:23 (twice in verse); Jonah 1:4 (twice in verse) + often; the Mediterranean is called also הַגָּדוֺל הַיָּם‎ Num 34:6-7, Josh 15:12, 47; Ezek 48:28 +, compare ׳הַיּ ׳גּ יָדַיִם וּרְחַב‎ Psa 104:25; הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ חַגּ ׳הַיָּם מְבוֺא‎ Josh 1:4; 23:4 (see Assyrian name of Mediterranean tiamtu rabitu ša sulmu šamši, etc., SchrNamender Meere. 171 ff.); ׳הַיּ ׳הַגּ הַלְּבָנוֺן אֶלמֿוּל‎ 9:1; ׳הַיּ הָאַחֲרוֺן‎ the hinder sea Deut 11:24; 34:2; Zech 14:8; Joel 2:20 (in the last two opposed to ׳הַיּ הַקַּדְמֹנִי‎, see below); of Mediterranean in particular part מְּלִשְׁתִּים יָם‎ Exod 23:31 (JE); יָפוֺ יָם‎2Chr 2:15 = יָפוֺא יָם‎ Ezra 3:7. **Of Mediterranean in plural Dan 11:45 [compare 8 d] Hi Ke Meinh Bev Dr (world-encircling seas Behrm).

2 יַםסֿוּף‎ 'Red Sea' (see סוּף‎) Exod 13:18 (compare 10:19), 15:4; Num 14:25; Deut 1:40; Josh 2:10; Judg 11:16 + often; also הַיָּם‎ Exod 14:2 (twice in verse); 14:9; Isa 51:10 (twice in verse); 63:11 +; probably also יָםמִֿצְרַיִם‎ 11:15; 'Red Sea' named or referred to approximately 66 t.; יִםסֿוּף‎ clearly of lanitic Gulf 1Kin 9:26 (compare 2Chr 8:17).

3 Dead Sea, מֶלַח יָם‎ sea of salt Gen 14:3; Num 34:3, 12; Deut 3:17; Josh 3:16; 12:3; 15:2, 5; 18:19; הָעֲרָבָה יָם‎ Deut 3:17; 4:49; Josh 3:16; 12:3; 2Kin 14:25; ׳הַי הַקַּדְמֹנִי‎ Ezek 47:18; Zech 14:8; Joel 2:29 (see above); simply יָם‎ Isa 16:8; Jer 48:32; — in יַעְזֵר יָם‎ 48:32 יָם‎ is textual error, strike out with Gf Gr Che Gie.

4 Sea of Galilee כִּנֶּרֶת יָם‎ Num 34:11; Josh 13:27; כִּנְּרוֺת יָם‎ 12:3; simply יָם‎ Deut 33:23.

5 more Generally sea, opposed to earth and (or) sky Gen 1:26, 28; 9:2 (P), Exod 20:11 (E), Hag 2:6 +? Job, Psalms, Isa2 etc.; Amos 6:12 read יָם בַּבָּקָר‎ for בקרים‎ (see בָּקָר‎); sea as under earth Psa 24:2 (compare Gen 1:10; 6:11; Exod 20:5 = Deut 5:3); figurative of flood of invaders, הַיָּם עַלבָּֿבֶל עָלָה‎ Jer 51:42.

6 of a mighty river, the Nile Nahum 3:8 (twice in verse); Isa 19:5 (|| נָהָר‎); compare בַּיָּם אֲשֶׁר הַתַּנִּין‎ 27:1 and בַּיַּמִּים כַּתַּנִּים‎ Ezek 32:2 (simile of Pharaoh); of Euphrates Isa 21:1; Jer 51:36 (according to Che Gf and others; Isa 21:1 perhaps better of Persian Gulf, see Di).

7 the great basin in temple-court, called the sea: מוּצָק אֶתהַֿיָּם וַיַּעַשׂ‎ 1Kin 7:23 2Chr 4:2; הַנְּחשֶׁת יָם‎ 2Kin 25:13; 1Chr 18:8; Jer 52:17; הַיָּם‎ alone 1Kin 7:24-25, 10t. Kings Chronicles + Jer 52:20.

8 combinations are:

a. shore of sea, sea-shore הַיָּם שְׂפַת‎ Josh 11:4; 1Kin 5:9, and in simile Gen 22:17; Judg 7:12; 1Sam 13:5; הַי ׳חוֺף‎ Josh 9:1; Ezek 25:16; יַמִּים חוֺף‎ Gen 49:13; Judg 5:17; compare הַיָּם חֶבֶל‎ Zeph 2:5 region by the sea; so 2:6 but dubious, see I. חֶבֶל‎

3. b. sand of the sea (shore) הַיָּם חוֺל‎ (in simile) Gen 32:13; 41:49; Hosea 2:1; Isa 10:22 + often (see חוֺל‎); לַיָּם גְּבוּל חוֺל‎ Jer 5:22.

H3225. yamin

I. יָמִין‎137 noun feminineExod 15:6 (Prov 27:16 no except, see Now Str) right hand (Late Hebrew id.; SI3 מימן‎ on the right; Aramaic יַמִּינָא‎, ; Arabic right, right side, right hand, south; Ethiopic right hand, right side, Sabean ימן‎ right hand, ימנת‎ soth, are also quoted; Assyrian imnu, right, right side, on the right, DlHWB 307) — absolute יָמִין‎ Gen 13:9 40t.; construct יְמִין‎ 1Sam 23:24 19t.; suffix יְמִינִי‎ Jer 22:24 6t., etc.; always singular: —

1 right hand:

a. literally of man, often opposed to שׂמאֹול‎ Gen 48:13-14, (compare 48:18), Dan 12:7; לִשְׂמאֹלוֺ בֵּיןיְֿמִינוֺ יָדַע‎ Jonah 4:11 distinguish between one's right hand and one's left; ימים שׁלח‎ Judg 5:26 (|| יד‎); as holding the lot Ezek 21:27; also of right hand as skilful Psa 137:5; as receiving bribes 26:10 (|| יָדַיִן‎); used in false swearing שֶׁקֶר וְמִין יְמִינָם‎ 144:8; 144:11 their right hand is a right hand of falsehood; oft also with יַדיִֿמִינוֺ יַד,‎ Gen 48:17 (E) hand of his right = his right hand Judg 7:20; 2Sam 20:9; יַדיְֿמִינוֺ אִטֵּר‎ Judg 3:15; 20:16 bound as to one's right hand, i.e. left-handed.

b. figurative, of right hand as held by ׳י‎ Isa 41:13; 45:1; so יַדיֿמיני‎ Psa 73:23.

c. right hand of ׳י‎, as instrument of delivering Israel Exod 15:6 (twice in verse); 15:12 +, compare יְמִינוֺ יֵשַׁע בִּגְכוּרוֺת‎ Psa 20:7; עֶלְיוֺן יְמִין שְׁנוֺת‎ 77:11; || זְרוֺעַ‎ 98:1; as acquiring the temple-site 78:54; as holding his servant 18:36 (line omitted in || 2Sam 22:36), compare Psa 63:9 & צִדְקִי בִּימִין‎ Isa 41:10; as finding, lighting upon (מצא‎) his enemies Psa 21:9 (|| יד‎); as full of צֶדֶק‎ 48:11; as dispensing blessings 16:11 בימינך נעימות‎ (compare Prov 3:16 of wisdom, personified); used in divine oath is Psa 62:8 (|| זְרוֺעַ‎).

2 of situation on, or direction toward, the right:

a. of situation, with וּמְשְּׂמאֹלָם מִימִינָם מִן,‎ Exod 14:22, 29 a wall on their right hand and on their left hand; similarly 2Sam 16:6; 1Kin 7:39, 49 2Chr 3:17; 4:6; 1Kin 22:19 (= 2Chr 18:18 with על‎), 4:7-8, Psa 91:7 (|| מִצִּדְּךָ‎); for protection 16:8; ל מימין‎ 2Kin 23:13; Ezek 10:3; with לִימִינוֺ וַתֵּשֶׁב לְ,‎ 1Kin 2:19, so Psa 110:1; 45:10; 109:31; with עַלֿ‎ Zech 3:1; 1Chr 6:24; 2Chr 18:18 (= 1Kin 22:19 with מן‎), Neh 8:4; Job 30:12; Psa 109:6; compare 110:5; without preposition הָעִיר יְמִין‎ 2Sam 24:5; Job 23:9.

b. of direction toward, literal ימין נָטָה‎ Num 20:17; 22:26 (both J E); ימין סוּר‎ Deut 2:27; 1Sam 6:12; ושׂ ימין ׳מָּרַץ‎ Isa 54:3; also (verb הִמָּרֶד‎ in prev. clause) Gen 13:9; ימין הַבֵּיט‎ Psa 142:5; and looking is implied also in Ezek 1:10 (with אֶלֿ‎; opposed to מֵהַשְּׂמאֹול‎); with הַיָּמִין על (לָלֶכֶת) נטה עַל,‎ 2Sam 2:19, 21; עליֿמין פנה‎ Gen 24:49; followed by אֶל‎, of course (הלך‎) of boundary Josh 17:1; with לַחוֺמָה מֵעַל לַיָמִין לְ,‎ Neh 12:31 (verb omitted, went) to the right above the wall; figurative of moral deviation, וּשְׂמאֹול מִןהַֿדָּבָריָ֗֗֗מִין סוּר‎ Deut 17:11, so 5:29; 17:20; 28:14; Josh 1:7; 23:6; 2Kin 22:2 2Chr 34:2; ושׂ ימין ׳נטה‎ Prov 4:27; also (very late) of the right as morally good, לִימִינוֺ חָכָן לֵב‎ (opposed to שׂמאל‎) Eccl 10:2 De Reuss Now.

3 of other parts of the body, besides hand (see יַדיֿמינו‎ etc. above): right thigh יְמִינוֺ יֶרֶךְ‎ Judg 3:16, 24; eye יָמִין עֵין‎ 1Sam 11:2; ימינו עין‎ Zech 11:17 (twice in verse); especially הַיָּמִין שׁוֺק‎ i.e. the right (upper) leg of sacrificial animal Exod 29:22; Lev 7:32-33, 8:25-26, 9:21; Num 18:18.

4 = south, because when facing east the right hand is toward the south: הַיְשִׁימוֺן מִימִין‎ 1Sam 23:19; אֶליְֿמִין‎ 23:24; מִימִינֵךְ ישׁב‎ Ezek 16:46 (|| עלשֿׂמאולך‎); וְיָמִין צָפוֺן‎ Psa 89:13; perhaps also 107:3, see יָם‎ 9

-el יִפְתַּחאֵֿל‎ proper name, of a location (God openeth; compare Sabean proper name, masculineיפתחאל‎ Hal148, l); — in ׳גֵּייִפ‎ (Γαφαηλ, Γαι και Φθαιηλ A ᵐ5‎L Γαι (Ι)εφθαηλ), valley between Zebulun and Asher Josh 19:14, 27 (P); probably near Jêfât (Jotapata), and perhaps upper part of Wady `Abellîn, see BuhlGeogr.109, 223.

יצא.def:
H3318. yatsa

יָצָא‎1068 verb go or come out (Late Hebrew id.; Aramaic יְעָא‎; Ethiopic , Assyrian âƒû DlHWB 237, all = go out, forth; Syriac go forth (in sense of germinate), grow; Phoenician יצא‎ march out; compare SI5 המוצא‎ the source (of water); Sabean וצַא‎ go out, DHM in MV; Arabic is be or become fair, beautiful, neat, clean, compare NöZMG 1886, 725) — Perfect יָצָא‎ Gen 10:11 92t.; 3 feminine singular יָָֽצְאָה‎ Num 16:35 13t.; יָצָ֑אָה‎ Isa 28:29; 2masculine singular יָצָאתָ‎ Gen 24:5 7t.; 2 feminine singular וְיָצָאת‎ Jer 31:4; 2masculine plural יְצָאתֶם‎ Exod 13:3; Deut 11:10 וִיצָאתֶם‎ Judg 21:21; Malachi 3:20; 3plural suffix יְצָאֻנִי‎ Jer 10:20, etc.; Imperfect יֵצֵא‎ Gen 15:4 64t.; וַיֵּצֵא‎ 4:16 132t.; 3 feminine singular תֵּצֵא‎ Exod 21:7 22t.; וַתֵּצֵא‎ Gen 30:16 14t.; 2 masculine singular תֵּצֵא‎ Deut 20:1 16t.; 3 plural יֵצְאוּ‎ Gen 15:14 +; יֵצֵ֑אוּ‎ 17:6 +; 3 feminine plural וַתֵּצֶ֫אנָה‎ 1Sam 18:6; 2Kin 2:24; וַתֵּצֶאןָ‎ Exod 15:20; 2feminine plural תֵּצֶ֫אנָה‎ Amos 4:3, etc.; Imperative צֵא‎ Gen 8:16 15t.; וָצֵ֑אָה‎ Judg 9:29; feminine singular צְאִי‎ Song 1:8; masculine plural Gen 19:14 11t.; צֵ֑אוּ‎ Isa 49:9; Ezek 9:7 + Jer 58:8 Qr (Kt יֵצֵ֑אוּ‎) צְאֶינָה‎ Song 3:11; Infinitive absolute יָצוֺא‎ Gen 8:7 2t.; יָצאֹ‎ 27:30 3t.; Infinitive construct צֵאת‎ 24:11 31t.; suffix צֵאתִי‎ Exod 9:29 3t.; צֵאתֵנוּ‎ Josh 9:12; צֵאתְךָ‎ Deut 16:3 10t., etc.; Participle יֹצֵא (יוֺצֵא)‎ Gen 2:10 62t.; feminine singular שֶׁיֹּצָא‎ Eccl 10:5; יֹצֵאת׳(יו )‎ Gen 24:15 11t.; יֹצֵת‎ Deut 28:37, etc.; —

1 go or come out or forth:

a. from (מִן‎) a place, e.g. a tent Gen 31:33 (E; opposed to בְ בּוֺא‎), מוֺעֵד אֹהֶל מִמֶּתַח‎ Lev 8:33; 10:7 (P), compare מִןהַֿמִּקְדָּשׁ‎ 21:22 (H); from a house 2Sam 11:8, the doors (דלתי‎) of a house Josh 2:19 (JE), Judg 11:31; ביתו מִפֶתח‎ Exod 12:22 (JE), from a camp 1Sam 13:17; 2Kin 7:12, a city Gen 19:14 (J), 12:4 (P), 1Kin 11:29; 20:17; Micah 4:10, a cave 1Sam 24:9, the ark Gen 9:18 (J), 8:16, 19 (both P); out of vineyards Judg 21:21; followed by accusative אֶתהָֿעִיר‎ Gen 44:4 (E), Exod 9:29 (J); with בְּ‎ also, of gate Jer 17:19; Neh 2:13; followed by accusative local. פָ֑תַח אֵצֵא לֹא‎ Job 31:34; participle construct הֵַתּבָה יֹצְאֵי‎ Gen 9:10 (P), עִירוֺ שַׁעַר יֹצְאֵי‎ 34:24 (P); absolute Josh 2:5 (JE), Judg 3:24; Exod 34:34 (P), Num 33:3 (P; Israel going out [from Egypt]), 2 h 26:20 +; specify., of going out (מִן‎) from a land (of emigration) Gen 10:11, 14; 24:5 (all J); patric. of coming forth from (the land of) Egypt (the Exodus) Exod 12:41 (J), 13:3, 8; 23:15; 34:18; Num 11:20; 22:5 (all J E), and especially D, Deut 4:45-46, 9:7; 11:10; 16:3 (twice in verse); 16:6; 23:5; 24:9; 25:17; Josh 2:10; 5:4-5, 6 (all D), Num 33:1 (P), 1Kin 6:1; 8:9 2Chr 5:10; 2Kin 21:15; Jer 7:25; Hag 2:5; Psa 114:1.

b go forth from (the presence of) a person: Exod 8:26; 9:33; 10:6 (all followed by מֵעִם‎), Gen 44:28; Exod 5:20; Jer 2:37 (מֵאֵת‎), Judg 3:19 (מֵעָלָיו‎); followed by מִלִּפְנֵי‎ Gen 4:16 (J), 41:46; 47:10; Est 8:15; Eccl 10:5; followed by מְּנֵי מֵעִם‎ Job 1:12, מְּנֵי מֵאֵת‎ 2:7; followed by suffix יְצָאֻנִי‎ Jer 10:20 (see De Eccl 7:18).

c. in technical senses: absolute go forth, of emancipation Exod 21:2-3,(twice in verse); 21:4-5, 7 (3 t. in verse); 21:11 (all J E), compare יַדאֲֿרָם מִתַּחַת יצא‎ 2Kin 13:5; of release in the year of jubilee, land, etc. Lev 25:28, 30, 31, 33 (all H), 27:21 (P); also of a debtor-slave 25:54 (H); suffix divorce מִבֵּיתוֺ וְיָָֽצְאָה‎ Deut 24:2; of condemnation רָשָׁע יֵצֵא בְּהִשָּֽׁפְטוֺ‎ Psa 109:7 when he is judged let him go out as a criminal, i.e. be condemned: of bowels (מֵעִים‎) falling out by reason of disease 2Chr 21:15, 19.

d. of flight, involving escape: followed by הַחוּ֫צָה‎, || נוּס‎, flee Gen 39:12, 15 (J), תֵצֵא נָצאֹ כִּי‎ Jer 48:9; opposed to taken (by lot) 1Sam 14:41; מִמֶּ֑נָּה לָצֵאת לֹאיֿוּכְלוּ אֲשֶׁר רָעָה‎ Jer 11:11 calamity from which they shall not be able to escape; perhaps also אֶתכֻּֿלָּם יֵצֵא אֱלֹהִים יְרֵא‎ Eccl 7:18 he that feareth God shall escape (or be freed from, see De Hi-Now Mishna) all of them (see VB), — on accusative with יצא‎ see De.

e. depart נַפְשָׁהּ בְּצֵאת‎ Gen 35:18 i.e. when she was expiring; so רוּחוֺ תֵּצֵא‎ Psa 146:4; מִנָּבָל הַיַּיִן בְּצֵאת‎ 1Sam 25:27 i.e. when Nabal became sober; also figurative לִבָּם וַיֵּצֵא‎ Gen 42:28 (E) i.e. their heart failed (|| וַיֶּחֶרְדוּ‎); rust from (מִן‎) caldron Ezek 24:16 (see Co 12:5); of glory of ׳י‎ 10:18; כָּלהֲֿדָרָהּ בַּתצִֿיּוֺן מִן וַיֵּצֵא‎ Lam 1:6; hence infinitive = exit, end הַשָּׁנָה בְּצֵאת‎ Exod 23:16 (JE), and, refundantly, שְׁנַיִם לְיָמִים הַקֵּץ צֵאת כְּעֵת‎2Chr 21:19 i.e. at the end of two years

f. of inanimate things: river out of Eden Gen 2:10 (J), water out of rock Exod 17:6 (E), Num 20:11 (JE), from Lehi Judg 15:19; of molten calf out of fire Exod 32:24(E); of gold (after refining) Job 23:10 (absolute, in simile); in prophecy of fountain from house of ׳י‎ Ezek 47:1, 8, 12; Zech 14:8; Joel 4:18; of seed (semen virile) from man Lev 15:16, 32 (P), 22:4 (H); of weapon which has pierced body 2Sam 2:23 (מֵאַחֲרָיו‎), 2Kin 9:24 (מִלִּבּוֺ‎), Job 20:25 (מִגֵּוַה‎); הַמֶּלֶךְ מַשְׂאַת אַחֲרָיו וַתֵּצֵא‎ 2Sam 11:8 and there went out ( = was sent out) after him the king's portion (i.e. the food given by the king); idiomatically of expenditure of money 2Kin 12:13 (absolute, compare Hiph`il v.12:12); of swift movement of arrow from bow Zech 9:14 (like lightning), of lightning out of fire Ezek 1:13; absolute of sunrise (subject שֶׁמֶשׁ‎) Judg 5:31 (in simile), Gen 19:23, compare Isa 13:10 (so Assyrian, e.g. ultu ƒît šanši adi êrib šanši COT Gen 19:23); of rising of stars (כּוֺכָבִים‎) Neh 4:15; of sentence of judge Hab 1:4 (twice in verse); Psa 17:2; of judgment, or right appearing (with simile of light) Hosea 6:5 (read יֵצֵא כָאוֺר וּמִשְׁמָּטִי‎), Isa 62:1; of a lot יוֺסֵף לִבְנֵי הַנּוֺרָל וַיֵּצֵא‎ Josh 16:1 (JE), and especially P, Num 33:54; Josh 19:1, 17, 24, 32, 40; 21:4, compare also גּוֺרָלָם גְּבוּל ויצא‎ 18:11 (P)

g. with especial emphasis on idea of origin, source: hyssop out of the wall 1Kin 5:13; הדבר יצא מיהוה‎ Gen 24:50 (J) from ׳י‎ has the thing proceeded, of a providential arrangement, so י ׳מֵעִם‎ Isa 28:29; רֶשַׁע יֵצֵא מֵרְשָׁעִים‎ 1Sam 24:14 (an ancient proverb); of pollution proceeding from (מֵאֵת‎) prophets Jer 23:15; of fire from Heshbon Num 21:28 (JE), Jer 48:45, compare Judg 9:15, 20 (twice in verse); of fire י ׳מִלִּפְנֵי‎ Lev 9:24; 10:2, י ׳מֵאֵת‎ Num 16:35 (all P); in theophany לְרַגְליו רֶשֶׁף יצא‎ Hab 3:5; iniquity from unreceptive heart Psa 73:7 (see I. הֵלֶב‎

1); wrath י ׳מִלִּפְנֵי‎ Num 17:11 (P); absolute Jer 4:4 = 21:12; 23:19 = 30:23; so salvation Isa 51:5; מִמֶּךָּ יָָֽצְאָה וְנִשְׁמַתמִֿי‎ Job 26:4; of words going forth from mouth of speaker (of solemn or formal speech) יֵצֵא לֹא דָּבָר מִמִּיכֶם‎ Josh 6:10 (JE), Judg 11:26; 1Sam 2:3; Jer 44:17; Job 37:2; Est 7:8, also Num 30:3; 32:24 (both P); of ׳י‎s words going forth from his mouth, or from him Isa 45:23; 48:3; 51:4; 55:11; Ezek 33:30; of ׳י‎s words, instruction, command, etc., going froth Isa 2:3 = Micah 4:2 (from Jerusalem), Dan 9:23; of human commandment Est 1:19, compare 1:17.

h. of children as going forth from loins (of father) מִמֵּעִים‎ 2Sam 7:12; 16:11; מֵחֲלָצִים‎ Gen 35:11 (P), 1Kin 8:19 2Chr 6:9; followed by מִן‎ alone 2Kin 20:18 = Isa 39:7; also יְרֵכוֺ יֹצְאֵי‎ Judg 8:30; Gen 46:26; Exod 1:5 (both P); also of birth מֵרֶחֶם‎ (אִמּוֺ‎) Num 12:12 (JE), Jer 1:5; 20:18; Job 3:11; figurative of sea 38:9; of ice 38:29; אִמּוֺ מִבֶּטֶן‎ 1:21; Eccl 5:14; literal, source not expressed, Gen 25:25-26, 38:28-29, 30 (all J); of untimely birth Exod 21:22 (JE); compare רַגְלֶיהָ מִבֵּין היּוֺצֵ֯ת‎ Deut 28:57 (|| תֵּלֵד‎); of family or race connection (followed by מִן‎) Nahum 1:11; Isa 48:1; 1Chr 1:12; 2:53; יצא‎ also of produce of vine (מִגֶּפֶן‎) Judg 13:14, compare הַשָּׂדֶה הַיֹּצֵא‎ Deut 14:22 (read ⅏ יצא‎, see Di); לֶחֶם יצא מִמֶּנָּה אֶרֶץ‎ Job 28:5; of viper proceeding from serpent's root Isa 14:29; further, with idea of unfolding, growth Job 8:16; 14:2; 31:40; יִשָׁ֑י מִגֶּזַע חֹטֶר וְיָצָא‎ Isa 11:1; of the little horn Dan 8:9; so of branches of candlestick in tabernacle Exod 25:32-33, 35; 37:18-19, 21 (all P); then simply project (tower from wall) Neh 3:25-26, 27; of measuring-line going forth (absolute) in a particular direction Jer 31:39; of a boundary (-line) going out (absolute) so as then to turn and make an angle Num 34:4, 9; Josh 15:3-4, 9, 11 (twice in verse); 16:2, 6, 7; 18:15 (twice in verse); 18:17 (twice in verse); 19:12-13, 27, 34, 47.

2. a. go forth to a place Gen 27:3 (J), Jer 14:18; Ezek 3:22; Zech 6:6 (twice in verse); 6:7 +; so הַמַּרְשְׁדֹ֫נָה וַיֵּצֵא‎ Judg 3:22 (see VB); go forth in surrender 1Sam 11:3 (followed by אֶל‎ person) 2Kin 18:31 = Isa 36:16; Jer 38:17, 21; יוֺצֵאת וְאֵין מֶּרֶץ אֵין‎ Psa 144:14; into captivity בַּגּוֺלָה אִתְּכֶם יָָֽצְאוּ לֹא‎ Jer 29:16, compare 48:7; Zech 14:2; also הַזֶּה מִןהַֿמָּקוֺם יָצָא‎ Jer 22:11, compare יְצָאֻנִי בָּנַי‎ 10:20.

b. go forward proceed to or toward something, figurative, יָצָ֑אוּ רָעָה אֶלֿ מֵרָעָה‎ Jer 9:2 from evil to evil they go on; in like manner 2Sam 20:8 si vera lectio, but read rather יָָֽצְאָה וְהִיא‎ and it (i.e. the sword) came out (of the sheath) and fell ᵐ5‎ We Dr Kit Bu.

c. come or go forth, with especially reference to purpose or result: וְהִכִּתִיו אַחֲרָיו וְיָצָאתִי‎ 1Sam 17:35, compare 24:15; נַפְשׁוֺ לְבַקֵּשׁ שָׁאוּל יָצָא‎ 23:15, compare 26:20, further 2Sam 2:13; 18:4; 1Kin 20:18 (twice in verse); 20:19, 39; 2Kin 5:2; Micah 1:11; Jer 37:5; Zech 14:3; Dan 11:11, 44 +; of an adulteress Prov 7:15; of an angel Num 22:32 (JE), Dan 9:22; for אִתְּכֶם ֗֗֗ יֵצֵא‎ 1Sam 22:3 (let my father etc.go forth [to be] with you, compare Klo) read perhaps יֵשְׁבוּ‎ as ᵑ9 ᵑ6‎ Kit, see also Dr; of army marching out to form battle line אֶלהַֿמַּעֲרָכָה יֹצֵא‎ 17:20 (with article, ᵑ0‎, < omitted by We Dr Kit Bu); יָָֽצְאוּ אֲשֶׁר בְּכֹל‎ Judg 2:15 in all to which they went forth, לפני יָצָא‎ 1Sam 8:20 of king going out at the head of his soldiers; so of ׳י‎ before his people Judg 4:14; 2Sam 5:24; Psa 68:8, compare 108:12; 1Chr 14:15; of ׳י‎ going out from Seir Judg 5:14, compare Hab 3:13; of the hand of ׳י‎, in hostility יַדיֿ בִי ׳יָָֽצְאָה‎ Ruth 1:13; absolute of fire breaking out Exod 22:5 (JE).

3 of combinations, note esp.: וָשׁוֺב יָצוֺא‎ (infinitive absolute) Gen 8:7 going out and returning, nearly = to and fro; וּמְקַלֵּל יָצוֺא יֹצֵא ֗֗֗ יוֺצֵא אִישׁ‎ 2Sam 16:5 = coming forth, cursing as he came; ובא יצא‎, literal בָּא וְאֵין יוֺצֵא אֵין‎ Josh 6:1 none went out and none came in, i.e. there was no free egress or ingress (of besieged city), compare 1Kin 15:17 2Chr 16:1; 15:5; to go out and come in before, of leader in war Num 27:17; 1Sam 18:16, compare 29:6; figurative Deut 28:6 blessed shalt thou be ובצאתך בבואך‎, i.e. when thou completest and beginnest any undertaking, so 28:19; 31:2 ולבוא לצאת אוכל לא‎, i.e. I can no more engage in active undertakings; similarly Josh 14:11; 1Kin 3:7; Isa 37:28 ( + שִׁבְתְּךָ‎) = 2Kin 19:27; Psa 121:8.

Hiph`il278 Perfect הוֺצִיא‎ Gen 14:18 +; וְהוֺצִא‎ consecutive Deut 22:14; הוֺצֵאתָ‎ Exod 32:11 7t.; וְהוֺצֵאתָ֫‎ Num 20:8 3t.; 2 feminine singular וְהוֺצֵאת‎ 1Kin 17:13; suffix הוֺצִיאַ֫נִי‎ Ezek 42:15; הוֺצִיאָ֫נוּ‎ Exod 13:14 2t.; הוֺצִיאֲךָ‎ Deut 6:12; 16:1, הוֺצִאֲךָ‎ Exod 13:9; Deut 7:19; הוֺצִיאָם‎ Exod 32:12 2t., etc.; Imperfect יוֺצִיא (יֹצִא)‎ Lev 16:27 9t.; וַיּוֺצֵא (וַיּצֵא)‎ Gen 15:5 23t.; וַיּוֺצִא (וַיֹּצִא)‎ Deut 4:20 4t.; suffix יוֺצִיאֵנִי‎ Micah 7:9; וַיּוֺצִאֲךָ‎ Deut 4:37; 5:15; וַיּוֺצִאָהּ‎ Exod 4:6-7, 3feminine singular תּוֺצִיא‎ Isa 61:11; Hag 1:11; jussive תּוֺצֵא‎ Gen 1:24; וַתּוֺצֵא‎ 1:12; Ruth 2:18; 2masculine singular תּוֺצִיא‎ Exod 12:46 5t.; חֲתֹצִיא‎ Job 38:32; וַתֹּצֵא‎ Jer 32:21; וַיּוֺצִיאוּ (וַיֹּצִאוּ)‎ Lev 24:23 +; suffix וַיּוֺצִיאֻהוּ‎ 2Kin 12:12; וַיֹּצִאֻהוּ‎ Gen 19:16; וַיֹּצִיאֻהוּ‎ 1Kin 21:13; יוֺצִיאוּם‎ 1Chr 9:28, etc.; Imperative הוֺצֵא‎ Gen 19:12 5t. + 8:17 Kt (Qr הַיְצֵא‎); הוֺצִיא‎ Isa 43:8; הוֺצִ֫יאָה‎ Psalm 142:8; suffix הוֺצִיאֵנִי‎ Psa 25:17; 1Kin 22:34, etc.; Infinitive construct הוֺצִיא‎ Exod 6:13 +; suffix הוֺצִיאִי (הוֺצִאִי)‎ 16:32 +; לְהוֺצִאֵהוּ‎ Jer 39:14, anomalous (Köi. 642), etc.; Participle מוֺצִיא‎ Exod 6:7 11t.; מוֺצֵא‎ Psa 135:7; suffix מוֺצִיאִי‎ 2Sam 22:49, מוֺצִיאֲךָ‎ Deut 8:14; 13:11, etc.; —

1 cause to go or come out, bring out, lead out:

a. a person from a place, + מִן‎ local, out of prison, etc. Gen 40:14 (E), Jer 20:3; 52:31 (not || 2Kin 25:27); so with the servant of ׳י‎ subject Isa 42:7; out of house Josh 6:22 (JE), a city Gen 19:12 (J), Ezek 14:22 (so ᵑ9 ᵑ6 ᵐ5‎ Co VB; ᵑ0‎ Hoph`al); of ׳י‎ bringing people of Jerusalem out of city to deliver them to enemy 11:7 (ᵑ0‎ (one) shall bring, but read 1 singular, see VB), 11:9; from a land Jeremiah 26:33; especially of Moses bringing Israelites out of Egypt Exod 3:10-11, 12 (E), 14:11 (J); of Moses and Aaron 6:13, 26, 27 (P); of ׳י‎ bringing Israelites out of (מִן‎) Egypt 18:1; 20:2; Josh 24:6 (all E), Exod 13:3, 9, 14, 16; 32:11; Num 20:16; 23:22; 24:8 (all J E), Deut 1:27; 4:20, 37; 5:6, 15; 6:12, 21, 23; 8:14; 9:12, 26, 28; 13:6; 13:11; 16:1; 26:8 (all D), Lev 19:36; 22:33; 23:43; 25:38, 44, 55; 26:13, 45 (all H), Exod 6:6-7, (מצרים סִבְלֹת מִתַּחַת‎), 7:4-5, 12:17, 42, 51; 16:6, 32; 29:46; Num 15:41 (all P), Judg 2:12; 6:8; 1Sam 12:8; 1Kin 8:16 2Chr 6:5; 1Kin 8:21, 51, 53; 9:9; Jer 7:22; 11:4; 31:32; 32:21; 34:13; Ezek 20:6, 10, compare 20:9 (strike out Co), 2Chr 7:22; Psa 136:11; Dan 9:15; absolute, same sense, Josh 24:5 (E), Deut 7:8, 19; Ezek 20:14, 22; Psa 105:37; 105:43; of ׳י‎ bringing Israelites out of exile (followed by מִן‎) Ezek 20:34, 41; 34:13; object rebels (out of, מִן‎, land) 20:38; of charioteer bringing Ahab out of battle 1Kin 22:34 2Chr 18:33; of Joseph's bringing out his sons from between Jacob's knees Gen 48:12 (E).

יקע.def:
H518. im

אִם‎ conjunction (= Aramaic if [and in , אֶלָּא‎ = if not, except], Arabic if [and in = if not, except], Ethiopic (§mma) if = מָה‎ + אִם‎ ( + ) [and in (allâ) if not, but], Assyrian umma; also in Arabic 'An?' = , compare הַאִם‎: see NöM p. 208, ZMG 1886, p. 739; WAG i. § 367 e) **ᵑ7‎Onk Jon ᵑ7 אִם,‎Hag אין‎.

1. hypothetical particle if.

a. construction (see more fully Dr§ 136-138, 143 FriedrichDie Hebr. Condit. sätze 1884): (1) with

imperfect (continued by perfects & waw consecutive; apodosis usually begins with perfect & waw consecutive or bare imperfect; or, if necessary, with imperative or jussive) (a) of future time: Gen 18:26 אִםאֶֿמְצָא‎ if I shall find 50 righteous in Sodom, וְנָשָׂאתִי‎ I will pardon, etc., 24:8; 32:9; Deut 19:8f.; 1Kin 1:52; b 6:12; Psa 89:31; Gen 42:37; Judg 13:16; 1Kin 1:52 a Psa 132:12. (b) of past time (rare, but classical): Gen 31:8 יאֹמַר אִם‎ if everhe said . . . וְיָָֽלְדִוּ‎ then they used to bear, etc., Exod 40:37; & in the protestations Job 31:7, 13, 16, 25 etc. (alternating with pff., see below, & with jussives in apodosis) (c) assuming a purely imaginary case (with imperfect in both clauses, like the double optative in Greek), if, though: Gen 13:16 so that אִםיֿוּכַל‎ if a man were able to number the stars, thy seed also יִמָּנֶה‎ might be numbered, Num 22:18; Isa 1:18 ח ׳אִםיִֿהְיוּ יַלְבִּינוּ כַּשָּׁנִים‎ though your sins were as scarlet, they should become white as snow, Amos 9:2-4 אִםיַֿחְתְּרוּ‎ though they were to dig into Sheôl, from thence תִּקָּחֵם‎ would my hand fetch them, Psa 27:3; 139:8 +. (2) with

participle (expressing either a present process, or an approaching future: apodosis as 1 a) Gen 24:42, 49; Judg 6:36; 9:15; 11:9 אַתֶּם מְשִׁיבִים אִם‎ if ye are going to bring me back . . . י ׳וְנָתַן‎ then ׳י‎ will, etc.; similarly with יֵשׁ‎ or אֵין‎ Gen 44:26; Exod 22:2; 1Sam 20:8; 23:23; & with no explicit copula Deut 22:2; 25:2; Lev 1:3, 14, etc. (3) with

perfect (a) of future or present time (continued by perfects & waw consecutive: apodosis as 1 a) Gen 43:9 לְפָנֶיךָ וְהִצַּגְתִּיו אֵלֶיךָ הֲבִיאֹתִיו אִםלֹֿא‎ if I do not bring him back (si eum non reduxero) and set him before thee, I will be guilty for ever, 47:6 if thou knowest that there are men of worth among them וְשַׂמְתָּם‎ then make them, etc., Judg 16:17; 2Sam 15:33; 2Kin 7:4; Psa 41:7; 94:18; Job 7:4; 9:30f. 10:14 וּשְׁמַרְתָּ֑נִי חָטָאתִי אִם‎ if I sin, thou watchest me. On אִםנָֿא‎ Gen 18:3 and elsewhere see נָא‎. (b) of past time, whether (a) in actual fact, or (β) in an assumed case (the perfect is here continued by the imperfect and waw consecutive; apodosis begins as before). (a) Judg 9:16-19 עֲשִׂיתֶם ֗֗֗ אִם‎ if ye have done honestly וַתַּמְלִיכוּ‎ and have made Abimelech king . . ., 1Sam 26:19; especially in protestations, as Psa 7:4 זאת עָשִׂיתִי אִם‎ if I have done this . . ., let the enemy pursue my soul, etc. Jer 33:25f.; Job 31:5f; 31:9, etc. (b) Num 5:27 if she have defiled herself וַתִּמְעֹל‎ and been faithless, וּבָאוּ‎ then shall they come, etc., 15:24; 35:22-24. (c) with bare perfect in apodosis, in sense of If ... had ..., only Deut 32:30 כִּי אִםלֹֿא‎ were it not that ..., Psa 73:15. (לוּ‎ is more usual in such cases.) (4) with

infinitive once (si vera 1.) Job 9:27 אָמְרִי אִם‎ = if I say (literally if (there is) my saying). — Note that the verb following אִם‎ is often strengthened by the infinitive absolute, as Exod 15:26; 19:5; 21:5; 22:3; 22:12; 22:16; 22:22; Judg 11:30; 14:12; 16:11 etc.; compare DrSm i. 20, 6.

b. Special uses: (1) repeated ... אִם אִם‎ whether ... or (sive ... sive) Exod 19:13; Deut 18:3; 2Sam 15:21; similarly וְאִם ֗֗֗ אִם‎ Gen 31:52; Jer 42:6; Ezek 2:5; Eccl 11:3; 12:14 (compare ... , ... PS250; ... & ... ).(2) After an oath (expressed, or merely implied) אִם‎ (the formula of imprecation being omitted) becomes an emphatic negative, and אִםלֹֿא‎ an emphatic affirmative: 2Sam 11:11 by thy life הַזֶּה אֶתהַֿדָּבָר אִםאֶֿעֱשֶׂה‎ (may God bring all manner of evil upon me) if I do this thing! = surely I will not do this thing! (compare the full phrases in 1Sam 3:17; 2Kin 6:31) Gen 14:23; 42:15; Num 14:23; 1Sam 3:14; 19:6; 2Kin 2:2; 3:14 & often; Isa 22:14; Psa 89:36; 95:11; Job 6:28; אִםלֹֿא‎ Num 14:28; Josh 14:9; 1Kin 20:23; 2Kin 9:26; Isa 5:9; 14:24; Jer 15:11; 49:20; Job 1:11 +? Ezekiel; after a negative clause, emphasizing a contrasted idea, Gen 24:38 (where the explanation by Aramaic אֶלָּא‎ is not supported by Hebrew usage), compare Jer 22:6. Repeated, וְאִם ֗֗֗ אִם‎ 2Sam 20:20; 2Kin 3:14; Isa 62:8; Jer 38:16; Ezek 14:16. In adjurations (with 2nd or 3rd person) = that not Gen 21:23; 26:29; 31:50; 1Sam 24:22; 1Kin 1:51; Song 2:7; 3:5 +. Of past or present time: 1Sam 25:34 as ׳י‎ liveth (I say) that, unless thou hadst hastened ..., נוֺתַר אִם כִּי‎ that surely there had not been left ...! 17:55 as thy soul liveth אִםיָֿדַעְתִּי‎ if I Know it! 1Kin 17:12; 18:10 — both אִםיֵֿשׁ‎ (כִּי‎ here merely introduces the fact sworn to, & need not be translated; so 2Sam 3:35: see כִּי‎); Psa 121:2 אִםלֹֿא‎ (after a negative clause: compare above Gen 24:38). compare Str§ 90.(3) Part, of wishing, if but ...! oh that ...! (rare) Psa 81:9 If thou wouldest hearken to me! 95:7; 139:19; Prov 24:11. compare Exod 32:32. With an imperative (si vera lectio) Job 34:16 וְאִםִֿבּינָה‎; and with an anacoluthon, Gen 23:13 (P) שְׁמָעֵנִי לוּ אִםאַֿתָּה‎ if thou! — oh that thou wouldst hear me!(4) Nearly = when — with the perfect: (a) of past, 38:9; Num 21:9 וְרָאָה ֗֗֗ אִםנָֿשַׁךְ וְהָיָה‎ and it used to be, if or when a serpent had bitten a man, that he would look, etc., Judg 6:3; Psa 78:34 (see Dr§ 136 δ Obs.); Amos 7:2. (b) of present or future, Isa 4:4 רָחַץ אִם‎ when the Lord shall have washed, 24:13; 28:25; compare Num 36:4 (with the imperfect)

c. Compounded with other particles: — (a) אִם בִּלְתִּי‎ except if, except, Gen 47:18; Judg 7:14; Amos 3:3-4,. (β) אִם הֲלוֺא‎ 2Kin 20:19 (for which Isa 39:7 has sim-ply כִּי‎), perhaps Is it not (good), if ...? (De Di). (γ) כִּיאִֿם‎, q. v. (δ) אִם עַד‎ Gen 24:19, 33; Isa 30:17; Ruth 2:21, & אִם אֲשֶׁר עַד‎ Gen 28:15; Num 32:17; Isa 6:11, until, properly until if or when. (ε) אִם רַק‎ if only (see below רַק‎). אִםלֹֿא‎ in Ezek 3:6b is very difficult. The Vrss render If I had sent, etc., implying לֻא‎ for אִםלֹֿא‎ (for Ew's אִםלֻֿא‎ = אִלּוּ‎, q. v., is precarious): Ges Hi Co 'but (אִםלֹֿא‎ after a negative, compare above Gen 24:38; Psa 131:2) unto them (Israel) have I sent thee: they can understand thee' (but understand is a dubious rendering of אֶל שָׁמַע‎).

2. Interrogative particle a. in direct question: (a) alone (not frequently and usually = Num? expecting the answer No, especially in a rhet. style): Gen 38:17; 1Kin 1:27; Judg 5:8 וָרֹמַח אִםיֵֿרָאֶה מָגֵן‎ was there a shield to be seen or a spear ...?Isa 29:16; and repeated Amos 3:6; Jer 48:27; Job 6:12. (b) more frequently in disjunctive interrogation: (a) אִם ֗֗֗ הֲ‎, expressing a real alternative Josh 5:13 אִםלְֿצָרֵינוּ אַתָּה הֲלָנוּ‎ art thou for us, or for our enemies? Judg 9:2; 1Kin 22:6, 15: more often expressing a merely formal alternative, especially in poetry (a rhetorical Num?) Gen 37:8; Num 11:12, 22; Judg 11:25b 2Sam 19:36; Isa 10:15; 66:8; Jer 3:5; Hab 3:8; Psa 77:10; 78:20; Job 4:17; 6:5-6, 10:4-5, 11:7 etc. (β) וְאִם ֗֗֗ הֲ‎ (rarer than אִם ֗֗֗ הֲ‎, but similar in use) 2Sam 24:13 (a real alt.); Isa 49:24; 50:2; Jer 5:9 (5:29 אִם‎) 14:22; Joel 1:2; Joel 4:4; Job 8:3; 11:2; 21:4; 22:3; 34:17; 40:8f. (formal); Gen 17:17 P (with an anacoluthon) shall a child ...? תֵּלֵד שָׁנָה הֲבַתתִּֿשְׁעִים וְאִםשָֿׂרָה‎ or Sarah, — shall she that is 90 years old bear? Prov 27:24 (וְאִם‎ after negative clause),

b. in oblique interrogation, if, whether: (a) alone, after verbs of seeing, inquiring, etc. 2Kin 1:2; Jer 5:1; 30:6; Mal 3:10; Psa 139:24; Cant 7:13; Lam 1:12; Ezra 2:59; once אִם יוֺדֵעַ מִי‎ who knoweth if ...? i.e. (like haud scio an) perhaps Est 4:14 (older synonym יוֺדֵעַ מִי‎ alone: see 2Sam 12:22; Joel 2:14; Jonah 3:9). (b) disjunctively אִם ֗֗֗ הֲ‎ Gen 27:21; Num 13:18-20; so וְאִם ֗֗֗ אִם‎ Josh 24:15.

c. compounded with הַאִם הֲ,‎ Numbers 17:28 לִגְוֺעַ תַּמְנוּ הַאִם‎ probably an emphatic Num? Shall we ever have finished dying? Job 6:13 difficult: perhaps Is it that my help is not in me? (a forcible means of expressing that that which might be thought impossible is nevertheless the case); Hi as an aposiop., If my help is not in me (am I still to wait) ? (The view that הַאִם‎ = הֲלֹא‎ nonne? is inconsistent with the fact that אִם‎ in a question has regularly the force of Num?)

אֵם‎ see אמם‎. Below

אֻמָּה אַמָּה,‎ see אמם‎.

אמה‎ (assumed as √ of following, which how-ever probably biliteral compare Sta§ 188; see also LagBN 82).

H3381. yarad

יָרַד‎380 verb come or go down, descend (Late Hebrew id.; MI32 וארד‎ and רד‎; Assyrian arâdu, DlHWB 240; Arabic come to, arrive at, also descend; Ethiopic descend; Sabean ורד‎ and הורד‎ id., DHM in MV) —

Qal306 Perfect יָרַד‎ Exod 19:18 +; יְרַד‎ Judg 5:13 (twice in verse) (but read יָרַד‎ or יֵרֵד‎); רַד‎ 19:11 (read יָרַד‎), etc.; Imperfect יֵרֵד‎ Gen 42:38 +; וַיֵּ֫רֶד‎ 11:5 +; וַיֵּרַ֑ד‎ 2Sam 22:10 2t.; 3 feminine singular (אֵשׁׅ תֵּ֫רֶד‎ 2Kin 1:10, 12; תּרַד‎ Jer 13:17; Lam 3:48; תֵּדֵֿ֔‎ Isa 34:5; 63:14; תֵּרֵ֑ד‎ Ezek 26:11 (יוֺרִיד‎ Vrss Co); וַתֵּ֫רֶד‎ Gen 24:16 7t.; 2 masculine singular תֵּרֵד‎ 26:2 5t. + 1Sam 20:19, where read תִּמָּקֵד‎ We Dr., compare ᵑ7 ᵑ6 ᵐ5‎; 1 singular אֵרֵד‎ Gen 37:35 3t.; וָאֵרֵד‎ Exod 3:8 3t.; cohortative אֵרְדָהנָֿא‎ Gen 18:21; יֵרְדוּ‎ 1Sam 13:12 4t.; וַיֵּרְדוּ‎ Gen 42:3 19t.; 3 feminine plural תֵּרַדְנָה‎ Jer 14:17 2t.; 1 plural נֵרֵד‎ Gen 43:5; cohortative נֵרְדָה‎ 11:7 2t.; וַנֵּ֫רֶד‎ 2Kin 10:13; Imperative רֵד‎ Exod 19:21 +; רְדָה‎ Gen 45:9; Ezek 32:19; רֵ֑דָה‎ 2Kin 1:9, 11; feminine singular רְדִי‎ Jer 48:18; Isa 47:1; masculine plural רְדוּ‎ Gen 42:2 5t.; Infinitive absolute יָרֹד‎ 43:20; construct רֶ֫דֶת‎ 44:26 +; (מֵ)רְדָה‎ 46:3 (see Köi. 402); suffix רִדְתִּי‎ Psa 30:10, etc. (in 30:4 read Kt מִיּוֺרְדֵי‎, so ᵑ6 ᵐ5‎ Che Bae, see Ol§§ 160 b, 245d); Participle יוֺרֵד‎ Judg 9:36 +; feminine singular יֹרְדָה‎ Lam 1:16; (הַ)יֹּרֶ֫דֶת‎ Eccl 3:21; 1Sam 25:30, etc.; —

1. a. come or go down: from (מִן‎) a mountain Exod 19:14; 32:1, 15 (all E), 34:29 (twice in verse) (JE), Deut 9:15; 10:5; Num 20:28 (P) +; absolute Exod 19:21, 24 (J), 19:25 (J; with אֶל‎ person); from the air, of birds, followed by עַל‎ Gen 15:11 (JE).

b. go down (usually from mountain or hill-country into plain), to battle, absolute Judg 5:14; followed by לָעֵמֶק‎ 1:34; followed by לַשְּׁעָרִים‎ 5:11; followed by אֶל‎ 5:10; 5:11, compare 1Sam 17:8 (followed by אֶל‎ person); followed by לִקְרַאת‎ Judg 7:24; followed by אַחֲרֵי‎ person 1Sam 14:36; followed by ב‎ location Judg 7:9; וְנִסְמָּה יֵרֵד בַּמִּלְחָמָה‎ 1Sam 26:10, compare 29:4; 30:24; of single combat, בַּשָּׁ֑בֶט אֵלָיו וַיַּרֶד‎ 2Sam 23:21 = 1Chr 11:23.

c. go down to (accusative) threshing-floor, Ruth 3:3, 5; (from David's palace) to Uriah's house (אֶל‎) 2Sam 11:9-10, (twice in verse); 11:13; from temple to (accusative) king's house Jer 36:12 (+ הַסֹּפֵר עַללִֿשְׁכַּת‎); יְהוּדָח בֵּיתמֶֿלֶךְ רֵד‎ 22:1, etc.

d. go down (absolute) from Palestine to Egypt Gen 42:3 (E), 42:38 (J) + 6 t. J E; followed by אֵלַי‎ 45:9 (E); followed by מִעְרַ֫יְמָה‎ 46:3-4, (E), 12:10; 26:2 (both J), Num 20:15 (JE); followed by מִצְרֵיִם‎ Josh 24:4 (E), Gen 43:15 (J), Isa 30:2; 31:1; 52:4; followed by שָׁמָּה‎ Gen 42:2 (E) ; so to Philistine cities Judg 14:19; 16:31; 1Sam 13:20; Amos 6:2.

e. from Jerusalem, absolute Judg 1:9; 1Kin 1:25; Neh 6:3; 2Chr 20:16 (to battle); to Jezreel 2Kin 8:21 = 9:26 2Chr 22:6; to Samaria 1Kin 22:2 2Chr 18:2; (to Gihon) 1 Samuel 1:38, etc.

f. from altar הַחַטָּאת מֵעֲשׂוֺת ירד‎ Lev 9:22 (P); from chariot, with מֵעַל‎ Judg 4:15; from ass, with מֵעַל‎ 1Sam 25:23; from throne, with מֵעַל‎ Ezek 26:16, absolute Isa 47:1, compare מִכָּבוֺד רְדִי‎ Jer 48:18; from ships, with מִן‎ Ezek 27:29; from bed, with מִן‎ 2Kin 1:4, 6, 16 (all opposed to עלה‎).

g. go down הָעַ֫יְנָה‎ Gen 24:16, 45 (J); followed by הַיְאֹר עַל לִרְחֹץ‎ Exod 2:5 (E), compare (absolute) 2Kin 5:14; followed by accusative הַסֶּלַע‎ 1Sam 23:25; הַיָּם יוֺרְדֵי‎ Isa 42:10; בָּאֳנִיּוֺת הַיָּם יוֺרְדֵי‎ Psa 107:23; absolute (into pit or well) 2Sam 23:30 = 1Chr 11:22, followed by שָׁם‎ (i.e. בְּאֵר‎) 2Sam 17:18. וְיָרַדְתִּי֯‎ Judg 11:37, read וְרַדְתִּי‎ (√ רוד‎, wander about), RS in Bla.

h. = sink, in water כְּמוֺאָֿ֑בֶן בִמְצוֺלוֺת יָָֽרְדוּ‎ Exod 15:5 (song in E); יָרַדְתִּי הָרַים לְקִצְבֵי‎ Jonah 2:7; more Generally, opposed to rising, בְקָעוֺת יֵָֽרְדוּ הָרִים יַעֲלוּ‎ Psa 104:8 mountains rise, valleys sink; תְהוֺמוֺת יֵרְדוּ שָׁמַיִם יַעֲלוּ‎ 107:26.

i. go down to She'ôl: followed by שְׁא֫וֺלָה‎ Gen 37:35 (J; + אֶלבְּֿנִי‎), Num 16:30, 33 (JE), Ezek 31:15, 17; followed by שְׁאוֺל‎ 32:27; Psa 55:16; Job 7:6 (opposed to עלה‎); תֵּרַדְנָה שְׁאֹל בַּדֵּי‎ 17:16; absolute Isa 5:14; Ezek 32:19 (|| הָשְׁכְּבָה‎), 32:21; 32:30, Psa 49:15 (followed by אַחֲרָיו‎); עֲרֵלִים יָָֽרְדוּ‎ Ezek 32:24; followed by שַׁחַת‎ Job 33:24, אֶלשַֿׁחַת‎ Psa 30:10; followed by בּוֺר‎ 30:4 Qr (Kt יורדי‎); אֶלאַֿבְנֵיבֿוֺר יוֺרְדֵי‎ Isa 14:19 ; בוֺר יוֺרְדֵי‎ Psa 28:1; Ezek 26:20 (twice in verse) (|| תַּחְתִיּוֺת אֶרֶץ‎) + 11 t. (see בּוֺר‎); עָפָר יוֺרְדֵי‎ Psa 22:30; דוּמָה יוֺרְדֵי‎ 115:17 (|| הַמֵּתִים‎); מָ֑וֶת יֹרְדֹת רַגְלֶיהָ‎ Prov 5:5, compare 7:27 (|| שְׁאוֺל דַּרְכֵי‎); note also לָאָרֶץ לְמִטָּה הִיא הַיּרֶדֶת הַבְּהֵמָה יוֺדֵעַר֗֗֗וּךְַ מִי‎ Eccl 3:21 (opposed to לְמָ֑עְלָה הִיא הָעֹלָה‎; read הַעֹלָה חֲיֹרדת,‎, with Vrss, see VB).

j. figurative בַּבֶּ֑כִי יֹרֵד‎ Isa 15:3 going down (dissolving) in tears (|| יְיֵלֵיל‎; compare 3c).

k. = be prostrated, absolute, of horses and riders Hag 2:22, compare Isa 34:7, perhaps also Jer 48:15; 50:27 (+ לַטָּ֑בַח‎); forest Isa 32:19; Zech 11:2; city Deut 20:20; Lam 1:9; wall Deut 28:52; nation מָ֑טָּה מַ֫טָּה תֵּרֵד‎ 28:43 (opposed to עלה‎); מַצֵּבוֺת‎ Ezek 26:11 + לָאָרֶץ‎ (where Co ויחרדו‎).

2 of divine manifestations: descend, of ׳י‎ in theoph. [ההר֑ על‎]׳י בָּאֵשׁ עָלָיו יָרַד‎ Exod 19:11, 18 (E), 19:20 (J; הָהָר אֶלרֿאֹשׁ‎), compare Neh 9:13; י ׳יֵרֵד עַלהַֿרצִֿיּוֺן לִצְבּאֹ צְבָאוֺת‎ Isa 31:4; absolute Gen 11:5, 7; 18:21; Exod 3:8 (all J), Num 11:17 (JE), 2Sam 22:10 = Psa 18:10 (compare 144:5), Micah 1:3; Isa 63:19; 64:2; ׳י בֶּעָנָן וַיֵּרֶד‎ Exod 34:5; Num 11:25, compare 12:5 (all J E); of pillar of cloud Exod 33:9 (JE); וַיֵּרַ֓ד עָלָהשָֿׁמַיִם מִי‎ Prov 30:4; of angels on סֻלָּם‎; בּוֺ וְיֹרְדִים עֹלִים‎ Gen 28:12 (E).

3 of inanimate things:

a. hail with עַל‎ person Exod 9:19 (J); dew with עַל‎ location Num 11:9 (JE), Psa 133:3; rain (as אָבָק‎ and עָפָר‎), followed by הַשָּׁמַיִם מִן‎ + על‎ person Deut 28:24, so in simile of future king עַלגֵּֿז כְּמָטָר יֵרֵד‎ Psa 72:6; of גְּשֶׁם‎ and שֶׁלֶג‎, with הַשָּׁמַיִם מִן‎ Isa 55:10; manna (with עַל‎ location) Num 11:9 (JE); fire from (מִן‎) heaven 2Kin 1:10 (twice in verse); 1:12 (twice in verse); 1:14; 2Chr 7:1, absolute 7:3.

b. waters, flowing down מִןהָֿהָר הַיֹּרֵד הַנַּחַל‎ Deut 9:21, compare Josh 3:13 (followed by מִלְמָ֑עָלָה‎), 3:16; followed by הָעֲרָבָה עַליַֿם‎ 3:16; עַלהָֿעֲרָבָה‎ Ezek 47:8; followed by מִן‎ 47:1.

c. tears, עֵינָ֑י יָָֽרְדוּ מַּלְגֵימַֿיִם‎ Psa 119:36, and so Lam 3:48; also מַיִם יֹרְדָה עֵינִי‎ 1:16, and so Jer 9:17; 13:17; 14:17 (compare also Isa 15:3, 1j).

d. of oil descending upon (על‎) beard, etc. Psa 133:2 (twice in verse).

e. of shadow on dial 2Kin 20:11 = Isa 38:8 (twice in verse).

f. of boundary going down (from or to a place) Josh 16:3 (JE), elsewhere P, Num 34:11 (twice in verse); 34:12; Josh 15:10; 16:7; 17:9; 18:13, 16.

g. come down, absolute of headdresses, in sign of humiliation Jer 13:18.

h. pride of power Ezek 30:6.

i. of calamity י ׳מֵאֵת‎ Micah 1:12; יֵרֵד חֲמָסוֺ עַלדְֿקְדוֺ‎ Psa 7:17; of sword descending on (על‎) Edom Isa 34:5.

j. figurative of words of talebearer; חַדְרֵיבָּֿ֑טֶן יָרְדוּ‎ Prov 18:8 = 26:22. — See also above 1k.

Hiph`il Perfect3masculine singular הוֺרִד‎ 2Kin 16:17; וְהוֺרִיד‎ consecutive Amos 3:11 (We וְהוּרַד‎); 2 masculine singular וְהוֺרַדְתָּ֫‎ 1Kin 2:9; 2feminine singular suffix הוֺרַדְתֵּנִי‎ Josh 2:18 (see Baern. and Köi. 412); הוֺרִידוּ‎ 1Sam 6:15; Lam 2:10 etc.; Imperfect3masculine singular וַיּוֺרֶד‎ Judg 7:5 5t. (+ 1Kin 6:32 Klo, who reads וַיֹּרֶד‎ for וַיָּרֶד‎, see רדד‎); suffix יוֺרִידֵנִי‎ Obadiah 3; יוֺרִדֵהוּ‎ 1Sam 30:16; 1Kin 17:23; וַיֹּרִדֵם‎ 18:40; 2masculine singular תּוֺרֵד וְלֹא‎ 2:6; suffix (הֲ)תוֺרִדֵנִי‎ 1Sam 30:15, תּוֺרִדֵם‎ Psalm 55:24 etc.; Imperative masculine singular הִוֺרֵד‎ Exod 33:5 2t.; suffix הוֺרִדֵהוּ‎ Ezek 32:18; הוֺרִידֵמוֺ‎ Psa 59:12; feminine singular הוֺרִידִי‎ Lam 2:18; masculine plural הוֺרִידוּ‎ Gen 43:7, 11; suffix הוֺרִדֻהוּ‎ 44:21; Infinitive construct לְהוֺרִיד‎ 37:25; suffix הוֺרִדִי‎ Ezek 31:16; Participle מוֺרִיד‎ 1Sam 2:6; מֹרִיד‎ 2Sam 22:48; — cause to come or go down:

1. a. bring down (to Egypt), with accusative of person + שָׁ֫מָּה‎ Gen 39:1 (J); + הֵ֫נָּה‎ 45:13 (E); + אֵלַי‎ 44:21; absolute 43:7; with accusative of thing 43:11; + מִצְרַ֫יְמָה‎ 37:25; absolute 43:22 (all J); from Canaan to desert Deut 1:25 (followed by אֵלֵינוּ‎); to (אֶל‎) Amalekites 1Sam 30:15 (twice in verse); absolute 30:16; bring down (object person or thing) אָלהַֿמַּיִם‎ Judg 7:4-5, אֶלנַֿ֫חַל‎ Deut 21:4; 1Kin 18:40; יָ֫מָּה‎ 1 Kings 5:23; to Gaza (עַזָּ֫תָה‎) Judg 16:21; from Jerusalem to Gihon, with עַל‎ (Qr אֶל‎) 1Kin 1:33; to valley of Jehosh. (אֶל‎) Joel 4:2; from (מִן‎) temple (to king's house) 2Kin 11:19 2Chr 23:20; from (מֵעַל‎) altar 1Kin 1:53; from (מִן‎) upper chamber, followed by הַבַּ֫יְתָה‎ 17:23; from (מִן‎) the heavens Amos 9:2; Edom, from (מִן‎) nest in rocks Jer 49:16; Obadiah 4; compare of Israel הַשָּׁמַיִם כְּעוֺף‎ Hosea 7:12; with accusative of limit (אֶרֶץ‎) Obadiah 3; bring down (from Babylon) into (בְּ‎) ships Isa 43:14 (see VB).

b. send down rain (הַגֶּשֶׁם‎) Ezek 34:26, compare Joel 2:23; = cause to flow down, object spittle, אֶלזְֿקָנוֺ רִירוֺ וַיּוֺרֶד‎ 1Sam 21:14; tears דִּמְעָה כַנַּחל הוֺרִידִי‎ Lam 2:18; water-streams מָ֑יִם כַּנְּהָרוֺת וַיּוֺרֶד‎ Psa 78:16.

c. = lay prostrate, prostrate עֻזֵּךְ מִמֵךְ הוֺרִיד‎ Amos 3:11 (where however We reads וְהוּרַד‎), compare Prov 21:22; יוֺשְׁבִים כַּאבִּיר וְאוֺרִיד‎ Isa 10:13; of God's casting down peoples Psa 56:8; Isa 63:6 (followed by לָאָרֶץ‎); תַּחְתֵּנוּ עַמִּים מוֺרִיד‎ 2Sam 22:48 (וַּיַּדְבֵּר‎ in || Psa 18:48); so perhaps Babylonians, like lambs, לִטְבֿוֺחַ‎ Jer 51:40; so Psa 59:12 (si vera lectio; וַהֲנִידֵמוֺ ᵑ6‎ make them vagabonds, see LagProph. Chald. (1872), xlviii. VB Hup Now Che Bae Dr2Sam 15:20).

d. bring down to She'ôl ׳י וַיָּ֑עַל׃ שְׁאוֺל מוֺרִיד וּמְחַיֶּ֑ה מֵמִית‎ 1Sam 2:6; followed by שְׁא(וֺ)ל‎ also 1Kin 2:6, 9; followed by שְׁא֫וֺלָה‎ (object grey hair) Gen 42:38; 44:29, 31 (all J); compare Ezekiel 26:30; Ezek 31:16; 32:18; followed by שַׁחַת לִבְאֵר‎ Psalm 55:24; לַשַּׁחַת‎ 28:8.

2 take down (from cart) 1Sam 6:15; the sea from upon (מֵעַל‎) the brazen oxen 2Kin 16:17; corpse from (מִן‎) tree Josh 8:29, and (מֵעַל‎) 10:27 (both J E); the מִשְׁכָּן‎ Num 1:51 (P); the מָּרֹכֶת‎ 4:5 (P); take off ornaments מֵעָלֶיךָ‎ Exod 33:5 (JE).

3 let down עַליָֿדָהּ כַּדָּהּ וַתֹּ֫רֶד‎ Gen 24:18, so, with מֵעָלֶיהָ‎ 24:46, to give one a drink; אָ֑רְצָה אֶתאַֿמְתַּחְתוֺ אִישׁ וַיּוֺרִדוּ‎ 44:11 (all J); object person Josh 2:18, הַחַלּוֺן בְּעַד בַּחֶבֶל‎ 2:15 (both J E); הַחַלּוֺן בְּעַד‎ 1Sam 19:12; compare also יְרוּשָׁלִַם בְּתוּלֹת ראֹשָׁן לָאָרֶץ הוֺרִידוּ‎ Lam 2:10 the virgins of Jerusalem have bowed down their heads to the ground.

Hoph`al Perfect הוּרַד‎ Gen 39:1-2t. + 1 Samuel 30:34 Kt (Qr

Qal Participle); וְהוּרַד‎ consecutive Zech 10:11; 2masculine singular וְהוּרַדְתָּ֫‎ Ezek 31:18; Imperfect2masculine singular תּוּרַד‎ Isa 14:15; —

1 be brought down מִצְרַ֫יְמָה‎ Gen 39:1 (J); בַּמִּלְחָמָה‎ 1Sam 30:24 Kt (see above); to She'ôl גְּאוֺנֶ֖ךָ שְׁאוֺל הוּרַד‎ Isa 14:11 (of king of Babylon); אֶליַֿרְכְּתֵיבֿוֺר תּוּרַד אֶלשְֿׁאוֺל‎ 14:15; תַּחְתִּית אֶלאֶֿרֶץ וְהוּרַדְתָּ֫‎ Ezek 31:18; אַשּׁוּר גְּאוֺן וְהוּרַד‎ Zech 10:11. — In Amos 3:11 We reads ממך וְהוּרַד‎ (see

Hiph`il above)

2 be taken down, of the מִשְׁכָּן‎ Num 10:17 (P).

H3383. Yarden

יַרְדֵּן‎182 proper name, of a river Jordan (according to Rel Ol§ 215 c, from ירד‎ with ןֵ֯‎ for original ןַ֯‎, compare ᵐ5‎ ὁ Ιορδανης; = river as flowing downward, descending, then of particular stream as river Κατ’ ἐξοχήν. See also Sta§ 294 e (ןֵ֯‎ for ןֶ֯‎, but name according to Sta non-Hebrew)) — absolute always ׳הַיַּר‎ in prose Gen 13:10 162t.; with ה‎ locative הַיַּרְדֵּ֫נָה‎ Judg 8:4 3t.; יַרְדֵּן‎ only Psa 42:7; Job 40:23; construct יַרְדֵּן‎ Num 26:3 11t.
